            observed = None
            duration = known_duration

        qq_gesture_armed = bool(
            qq_mouse_down or self._qq_mouse_is_down or
            now <= float(self._qq_gesture_recent_until_mono or 0.0)
        )
        qq_pending_gesture = bool(self._qq_seek_pending)
        # v99: the generic gesture guard intentionally remains 5.2s for seek/hover authority.
        # Cold-start *clock proof* can safely resume earlier once the mouse is released and
        # off the rail; it still needs the normal validated + advancing + duration-matched
        # stream proof before it can own the clock.
        qq_auto_anchor_gesture_safe = not qq_gesture_armed
        if not qq_auto_anchor_gesture_safe:
            try:
                release_age = now - float(self._qq_gesture_release_mono or 0.0)
                qq_auto_anchor_gesture_safe = bool(
                    not qq_mouse_down and not self._qq_mouse_is_down and
                    not qq_cursor_progress and not qq_pending_gesture and
                    float(self._qq_gesture_release_mono or 0.0) > 0.0 and
                    release_age >= float(QQ_INITIAL_ANCHOR_POST_GESTURE_GRACE_MS)
                )
            except Exception:
                qq_auto_anchor_gesture_safe = False

        # v81: QQ hover preview and real current-time share the same Text-pair surface.
        # The old cold-start shortcut accepted two repeated validated samples, so a static
        # hover preview could become the initial clock. Initial authority now needs a
        # validated stream that advances at approximately wall-clock speed while playing.
        qq_auto_anchor_confirmed = False
        if (
            LIVING_STACK_ENABLED and observed is not None and
            source_name in ('qq-time-pair-candidate', 'qq-time-pair-validated') and
            (self._auto_local_active or not self._uia_has_lock) and
            not qq_mouse_down and not self._qq_mouse_is_down and
            qq_auto_anchor_gesture_safe and not qq_pending_gesture
        ):
            confidence = int(ui.get('confidence') or 0)
            self._qq_auto_anchor_pending, advancing_proof = _qq_initial_anchor_stream_step(
                self._qq_auto_anchor_pending, observed, now, status, source_name, source_key, confidence
            )
            duration_ok = bool(duration and known_duration and known_duration > 0)
            if duration_ok:
                duration_tol = max(1800.0, float(known_duration) * 0.012)
                duration_ok = abs(float(duration) - float(known_duration)) <= duration_tol
            qq_auto_anchor_confirmed = bool(advancing_proof and duration_ok and not self._track_duration_pending)
            if qq_auto_anchor_confirmed:
                try:
                    p = self._qq_auto_anchor_pending or {}
                    write_error_log(
                        '自动切歌QQ首锚推进确认',
                        detail=(
                            f'observed={int(observed)}ms | duration={int(duration or 0)} | '
                            f'samples={int(p.get("samples", 0))} | '
                            f'span={int(now - float(p.get("first_mono", now)))}ms | '
                            f'progress={int(float(observed) - float(p.get("first_raw", observed)))}ms | '
                            f'cursor_over_rail={int(bool(qq_cursor_progress))}'
                        )
                    )
                except Exception:
                    pass
        elif (self._auto_local_active or not self._uia_has_lock) and observed is not None:
            self._qq_auto_anchor_pending = None

        # v1.8.9.14: NetEase sometimes drops/changes playback status exactly at the
        # loop boundary. Remember recent near-end evidence independently of the current
        # frame, then accept a duration-matched early position from the same cloudmusic
        # process as a legitimate wrap. Manual seek-to-start from the end benefits from
        # the same behavior: the lyric should also relocate immediately.
        process_stem = self._process_stem(process_name)
        loop_duration_probe = float(known_duration or duration or 0.0)
        if NETEASE_LOOP_RECOVERY_ENABLED and process_stem == 'cloudmusic' and loop_duration_probe >= 30000.0:
            end_window_probe = max(7000.0, min(18000.0, loop_duration_probe * 0.065))
            near_end_value = None
            if predicted is not None and float(predicted) >= loop_duration_probe - end_window_probe:
                near_end_value = float(predicted)
            if observed is not None and float(observed) >= loop_duration_probe - end_window_probe:
                near_end_value = max(float(observed), near_end_value or 0.0)
            duration_match = True
            if duration and known_duration:
                duration_match = abs(float(duration) - float(known_duration)) <= max(2800.0, loop_duration_probe * 0.025)
            if near_end_value is not None and duration_match:
                self._netease_loop_end_evidence = {
                    'mono': now, 'duration': loop_duration_probe, 'value': near_end_value,
                    'source_key': source_key, 'status': status,
                }
            elif self._netease_loop_end_evidence is not None:
                if now - float(self._netease_loop_end_evidence.get('mono', 0.0)) > 14000.0:
                    self._netease_loop_end_evidence = None
        elif process_stem != 'cloudmusic':
            self._netease_loop_end_evidence = None

        # v1.8.9.11/v1.8.9.14: a player-side single-track repeat does not change
        # title/artist. QQ can usually be proven in one playing frame; NetEase may need
        # the recent-end evidence above because status can flash paused/unknown.
        if SPREAD_LOOP_ENABLED and observed is not None:
            loop_duration = float(known_duration or duration or 0.0)
            duration_ok = bool(loop_duration >= 30000.0)
            if duration_ok and duration and known_duration:
                duration_tol = max(2500.0, loop_duration * 0.025)
                duration_ok = abs(float(duration) - float(known_duration)) <= duration_tol
            if duration_ok:
                end_window = max(6000.0, min(15000.0, loop_duration * 0.055))
                start_window = max(3500.0, min(8000.0, loop_duration * 0.032))
                direct_wrap = (
                    predicted is not None and status == 'playing' and
                    float(predicted) >= loop_duration - end_window and
                    float(observed) <= start_window and
                    int(ui.get('confidence') or 0) >= 108
                )
                recent_end_wrap = False
                if NETEASE_LOOP_RECOVERY_ENABLED and process_stem == 'cloudmusic':
                    ev = self._netease_loop_end_evidence
                    if ev is not None:
                        evidence_age = max(0.0, now - float(ev.get('mono', now)))
                        duration_close = abs(float(ev.get('duration', 0.0)) - loop_duration) <= max(2800.0, loop_duration * 0.025)
                        early_enough = float(observed) <= start_window
                        source_good = int(ui.get('confidence') or 0) >= 100 and source_name in {
                            'uia-doc-point', 'uia-point-probe', 'uia-fast-button', 'uia-time-pair'
                        }
                        recent_end_wrap = bool(
                            evidence_age <= 12000.0 and duration_close and early_enough and source_good and
                            status in ('playing', 'paused', 'unknown')
                        )
                loop_wrap = direct_wrap or recent_end_wrap
                if loop_wrap:
                    loop_value = float(observed)
                    if source_name == 'qq-time-pair-validated':
                        loop_value += 420.0
                    loop_value = max(0.0, min(loop_value, loop_duration))
                    self._cancel_seek_watchdog()
                    self._qq_seek_pending = None
                    self._playing_seek_pending = None
                    self._paused_seek_pending = None
                    self._uia_pending_far = None
                    self._uia_initial_pending = None
                    self._uia_reacquire_count = 0
                    self._uia_provisional = False
                    self._uia_provisional_started_mono = None
                    self._clear_visual_seek_override()
                    self._mark_seek_burst(loop_value, source_name or 'same-track-loop', now)
                    if SYNC_AUTHORITY_ENABLED and source_name.startswith('qq-'):
                        self._qq_reset_clock_authority()
                    self._uia_has_lock = True
                    self._uia_locked_source_key = source_key or self._uia_locked_source_key
                    self._uia_locked_source_name = source_name or self._uia_locked_source_name
                    self._uia_last_seen_mono = now
                    self._uia_last_observed_ms = float(observed)
                    self._uia_last_observed_source_name = source_name
                    self._uia_last_observed_source_key = source_key
                    if duration:
                        self._uia_duration_ms = duration
                    self._uia_position_ms = loop_value
                    self._uia_anchor_mono = now
                    self._uia_status = status
                    if process_stem == 'cloudmusic':
                        self._netease_loop_end_evidence = None
                    self._est_position_ms = loop_value
                    self._est_anchor_mono = now
                    self._est_status = status
                    self._sync_diag(
                        source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                        raw='UIA↻', estimated=int(loop_value), last=None, age=None,
                        end=int(loop_duration), mode='same-track-loop-wrap',
                        reason=(
                            f'end={int(loop_duration)}ms predicted={int(predicted) if predicted is not None else "None"}ms '
                            f'observed={int(observed)}ms source={source_name} '
                            f'netease_recent_end={int(bool(recent_end_wrap))}'
                        )
                    )
                    return int(loop_value), ui

        if (
            observed is not None and source_name.startswith('qq-') and
            now < float(self._qq_track_switch_hold_until_mono or 0.0)
        ):
            self._sync_diag(
                source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                raw='UIA~', estimated=None if predicted is None else int(predicted),
                last=None, age=None, end=duration, mode='qq-track-switch-hold',
                reason=f'observed={int(observed)}ms'
            )
            observed = None

        # Seek完成后QQ可能继续显示刚才的同一个整秒数秒。
        # 本地时钟已经前进时，只屏蔽真正仍停在commit整秒的旧回声。
        if (
            observed is not None and predicted is not None and
            source_name == 'qq-time-pair-validated' and status == 'playing' and
            self._qq_seek_last_commit_target is not None and
            (now - float(self._qq_seek_last_commit_mono or 0.0)) <= 5000.0 and
            float(predicted) - float(self._qq_seek_last_commit_target) >= 700.0 and
            abs(float(observed) - float(self._qq_seek_last_commit_target)) <= 500.0
        ):
            self._sync_diag(
                source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                raw='UIA~', estimated=int(predicted), last=None, age=None,
                end=duration, mode='qq-post-seek-stale-echo',
                reason=(
                    f'observed={int(observed)}ms '
                    f'commit={int(self._qq_seek_last_commit_target)}ms'
                )
            )
            observed = None

        # QQ 的进度条 hover 会把预览 mm:ss 暴露到*同一个*已验证 Text 控件。
        # v1.8.9.3 不再只拦“明显很远”的预览：只要光标停在 rail 且没有
        # 按下/近期真实手势，QQ Text 整体进入隔离区；冷启动也不允许 hover 值
        # 冒充第一把时钟锁，已有主时钟时则避免一个恰好靠近当前
        # 时间的 hover 值获得软校准权限。真正按下 rail 后会立即退出隔离并走 seek session。
        qq_hover_quarantine = bool(
            SOURCE_GUARD_ENABLED and SYNC_AUTHORITY_ENABLED and
            observed is not None and source_name.startswith('qq-time-pair') and
            qq_cursor_progress and not qq_mouse_down and not self._qq_mouse_is_down and
            not qq_gesture_armed and not qq_pending_gesture and
            not qq_auto_anchor_confirmed
        )
        qq_hover_safe_clock = False
        if qq_hover_quarantine:
            qq_hover_safe_clock = self._qq_note_hover_safe_clock(
                observed, predicted, source_name, source_key,
                int(ui.get('confidence') or 0), status, now
            )
            if qq_hover_safe_clock:
                p_hover = self._qq_hover_clock_pending or {}
                self._sync_diag(
                    source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                    raw='UIA~', estimated=None if predicted is None else int(predicted),
                    last=None, age=None, end=duration, mode='qq-hover-safe-clock',
                    reason=(
                        f'advancing={int(p_hover.get("samples", 0))} '
                        f'raw={int(float(observed))}ms predicted={int(float(predicted))}ms '
                        f'calibration-only=1'
                    )
                )
            else:
                self._qq_unarmed_far_pending = None
                self._qq_reset_clock_authority()
                self._sync_diag(
                    source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                    raw='UIA~', estimated=None if predicted is None else int(predicted),
                    last=None, age=None, end=duration, mode='qq-hover-rail-quarantine',
                    reason='cursor-over-rail-without-gesture; waiting advancing-clock proof'
                )
                observed = None
        else:
            self._qq_hover_clock_pending = None
        if (
            SOURCE_GUARD_ENABLED and
            observed is not None and predicted is not None and
            source_name.startswith('qq-time-pair') and
            qq_cursor_progress and not qq_mouse_down and not self._qq_mouse_is_down and
            not qq_hover_safe_clock and
            (
                (not PHASE_SEEK_FIX_ENABLED) or
                (not qq_gesture_armed and not qq_pending_gesture)
            ) and
            abs(float(observed) - float(predicted)) >= 1200.0
        ):
            self._sync_diag(
                source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                raw='UIA~', estimated=int(predicted), last=None, age=None,
                end=duration, mode='qq-hover-preview-ignore',
                reason=(
                    f'observed={int(observed)}ms predicted={int(predicted)}ms '
                    f'delta={int(float(observed)-float(predicted))}ms'
                )
            )
            observed = None

        # A far QQ sample without a bottom-rail gesture is usually hover contamination, but
        # lyric-page / keyboard seeks are also unarmed. Keep the quarantine for one-off values;
        # accept only a short coherent new clock stream from the validated compact time pair.
        if (
            observed is not None and predicted is not None and
            source_name.startswith('qq-time-pair') and
            abs(float(observed) - float(predicted)) >= (1800.0 if SOURCE_GUARD_ENABLED else 2500.0) and
            not qq_hover_safe_clock and
            not qq_gesture_armed and not qq_pending_gesture and
            not qq_auto_anchor_confirmed
        ):
            confirmed_unarmed = None
            if (
                PHASE_SEEK_FIX_ENABLED and source_name == 'qq-time-pair-validated' and
                int(ui.get('confidence') or 0) >= 160 and not qq_cursor_progress
            ):
                confirmed_unarmed = self._qq_note_unarmed_far_seek(
                    observed, predicted, duration, status, source_key, now
                )
            else:
                self._qq_unarmed_far_pending = None
            if confirmed_unarmed is not None:
                qq_unarmed_seek_target = float(confirmed_unarmed)
                self._sync_diag(
                    source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                    raw='UIA', estimated=int(qq_unarmed_seek_target), last=None, age=None,
                    end=duration, mode='qq-unarmed-stable-seek-commit',
                    reason=(
                        f'observed={int(observed)}ms predicted={int(predicted)}ms '
                        f'target={int(qq_unarmed_seek_target)}ms '
                        f'phase_carry={int(qq_unarmed_seek_target - float(observed) - (420.0 if status == "playing" else 0.0))}ms '
                        f'phase_samples={len(getattr(self, "_qq_seek_phase_samples", []) or [])} '
                        f'nonrail_click={int(bool(now <= float(getattr(self, "_qq_nonrail_click_until_mono", 0.0) or 0.0)))} '
                        f'source={source_name}'
                    )
                )
            else:
                if SYNC_AUTHORITY_ENABLED:
                    self._qq_reset_clock_authority()
                pending = self._qq_unarmed_far_pending or {}
                self._sync_diag(
                    source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                    raw='UIA~', estimated=int(predicted), last=None, age=None,
                    end=duration, mode='qq-unarmed-far-pending',
                    reason=(
                        f'observed={int(observed)}ms predicted={int(predicted)}ms '
                        f'delta={int(float(observed)-float(predicted))}ms '
                        f'stable={int(pending.get("stable_samples", 0))} '
                        f'nonrail_click={int(bool(pending.get("nonrail_click_fast")))}'
                    )
                )
            observed = None
        elif observed is not None and predicted is not None and source_name.startswith('qq-time-pair'):
            # Returning to the expected clock invalidates any unfinished unarmed candidate.
            self._qq_unarmed_far_pending = None
            if now > float(getattr(self, '_qq_lyric_click_target_until_mono', 0.0) or 0.0):
                self._qq_lyric_click_target_ms = None
                self._qq_lyric_click_target_until_mono = 0.0

        if observed is not None and duration and known_duration and known_duration > 0:
            tol = max(8000.0, float(known_duration) * 0.06)
            if abs(float(duration) - float(known_duration)) > tol:
                self._sync_diag(source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                                raw='UIA?', estimated=None, last=None, age=None,
                                end=duration, mode='uia-duration-reject',
                                reason=f'source={source_name} duration={int(duration)} expected={int(known_duration)} tol={int(tol)}')
                observed = None
                duration = known_duration
        if duration and not self._track_duration_pending:
            self._uia_duration_ms = duration

        chosen = predicted
        accepted_seek_this_sample = False
        confirmed_clock_this_sample = False
        if qq_unarmed_seek_target is not None:
            chosen = float(qq_unarmed_seek_target)
            accepted_seek_this_sample = True
            self._mark_seek_burst(
                chosen, 'qq-unarmed-stable-seek', now,
                suppress_serial=self._visual_seek_matches(chosen, now, tolerance_ms=3200.0)
            )
            self._clear_visual_seek_override()
            self._qq_seek_last_commit_mono = now
            self._qq_seek_last_commit_target = float(chosen)
            self._qq_post_seek_hard_rephase_done_mono = 0.0
            self._uia_provisional = False
            self._uia_provisional_started_mono = None
            self._uia_pending_far = None
            self._playing_seek_pending = None
            self._paused_seek_pending = None
            self._uia_reacquire_count = 0
            self._qq_reset_clock_authority()
        if observed is not None:
            observed = float(observed)
            # QQ UIA Text only exposes whole seconds. Treat the displayed second as the
            # middle of its 1-second bucket while playing; otherwise lyrics are systematically
            # ~0.5s late and the singer can get a few syllables ahead of the first character.
            if source_name == 'qq-time-pair-validated' and status == 'playing':
                observed += 420.0
                if duration is not None:
                    observed = min(observed, float(duration))
            # v81: duration match alone cannot validate a QQ Text pair because hover preview
            # carries the same total duration. Preserve it for pre-calibration only after the
            # stream has already demonstrated real forward playback progression.
            if self._track_duration_pending and duration and source_name.startswith('qq-time-pair'):
                try:
                    proof = bool((self._qq_auto_anchor_pending or {}).get('advancing_proof'))
                    if proof and source_name == 'qq-time-pair-validated':
                        self._duration_pending_ui_sample = {
                            'position_ms': float(observed), 'duration_ms': int(duration),
                            'mono': float(now), 'status': str(status or 'unknown'),
                            'source': str(source_name), 'confidence': int(ui.get('confidence') or 0),
                            'advancing_proof': True,
                        }
                    else:
                        self._duration_pending_ui_sample = None
                except Exception:
                    self._duration_pending_ui_sample = None

            qq_clock_calibration_trusted = False
            if (
                source_name == 'qq-time-pair-validated' and self._uia_has_lock and
                not qq_gesture_armed and not qq_pending_gesture
            ):
                qq_clock_calibration_trusted = self._qq_note_clock_sample(
                    process_name, status, observed, predicted, source_key, duration, now
                )
            gap_ms = None if self._uia_last_seen_mono is None else max(0.0, now - self._uia_last_seen_mono)

            # 首次锁定不相信单个样本。网易云偶尔会先吐出整页文本中的错误时间，
            # 下一次才出现真正的 “当前 / 总时长”。两次样本应按播放状态自然推进。
            if not self._uia_has_lock and chosen is None:
                pending = self._uia_initial_pending
                confidence = int(ui.get('confidence') or 0)
                strong_source = ui.get('source') in ('uia-preferred-control', 'uia-fast-button', 'uia-point-probe', 'uia-saved-locator', 'uia-slider', 'uia-slider-point', 'uia-compact-time', 'kugou-compact-time', 'kugou-slider-point', 'kugou-win32-time', 'kugou-win32-time-pair', 'kugou-win32-trackbar', 'kugou-msaa-time-pair', 'kugou-memory-time-pair', 'kugou-numeric-memory-cs', 'gsmtc-kugou-precise', 'qq-time-pair-validated')
                # 自动切歌刚检测到新标题时，歌词搜索与 UIA 扫描并行。
                # 在搜索返回官方时长前，弱 Document 时间对不能自证“总时长正确”。
                if self._track_duration_pending and not strong_source:
                    self._uia_initial_pending = None
                    self._sync_diag(
                        source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                        raw='UIA?', estimated=None, last=None, age=None,
                        end=duration, mode='uia-wait-track-duration',
                        reason=f'auto-track source={source_name} waiting lyric duration'
                    )
                # 小型、可持续读取的时间控件/进度条可信度足够高时立即锁定。
                # 整页文本即便恰好含有 mm:ss / mm:ss，仍必须经过第二个独立样本确认。
                elif confidence >= 140 and strong_source and (
                    source_name != 'qq-time-pair-validated' or qq_auto_anchor_confirmed
                ):
                    chosen = observed
                    self._uia_has_lock = True
                    self._uia_provisional = False
                    self._uia_provisional_started_mono = None
                    self._uia_locked_source_key = source_key
                    self._uia_locked_source_name = source_name
                    self._uia_initial_pending = None
                    self._uia_pending_far = None
                    self._uia_reacquire_count = 0
                    confirmed_clock_this_sample = True
                    self._sync_diag(source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                                    raw='UIA', estimated=int(chosen), last=None, age=None,
                                    end=duration, mode='uia-initial-lock-fast',
                                    reason=f'high-confidence source={ui.get("source")} confidence={confidence}')
                elif source_name in ('qq-time-pair-candidate', 'qq-time-pair-validated'):
                    self._uia_initial_pending = None
                    p = self._qq_auto_anchor_pending or {}
                    self._sync_diag(
                        source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                        raw='UIA?', estimated=None if predicted is None else int(predicted),
                        last=None, age=None, end=duration, mode='qq-initial-wait-advancing',
                        reason=(
                            f'source={source_name} confidence={confidence} '
                            f'samples={int(p.get("samples", 0))} '
                            f'advancing={int(bool(p.get("advancing_proof")))}'
                        )
                    )
                elif source_name == 'uia-doc-point' and confidence >= 110 and duration and self._uia_duration_ms:
                    # v1.8.8：只要 Document 命中的“当前 / 总时长”已经通过曲目总时长校验，
                    # 就先临时采用，不再让用户空等第二个 UIA 样本几十秒/几分钟。
                    # 这个锁仍是 provisional；后续强控件出现时可立即纠正。
                    chosen = observed
                    self._uia_has_lock = True
                    self._uia_provisional = True
                    self._uia_provisional_started_mono = now
                    self._uia_locked_source_key = source_key
                    self._uia_locked_source_name = source_name
                    self._uia_initial_pending = {
                        'value': observed, 'mono': now, 'duration': duration, 'count': 1,
                        'required': 2, 'source_key': source_key, 'source_name': source_name
                    }
                    self._uia_pending_far = None
                    self._uia_reacquire_count = 0
                    self._sync_diag(source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                                    raw='UIA~', estimated=int(chosen), last=None, age=None,
                                    end=duration, mode='uia-provisional-lock',
                                    reason=f'validated-doc first={int(observed)}ms; show-now-confirm-later')
                elif pending is None:
                    required = 2
                    self._uia_initial_pending = {
                        'value': observed, 'mono': now, 'duration': duration, 'count': 1,
                        'required': required, 'source_key': source_key, 'source_name': source_name
                    }
                    self._sync_diag(source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                                    raw='UIA?', estimated=None, last=None, age=None,
                                    end=duration, mode='uia-initial-candidate',
                                    reason=f'first={int(observed)}ms confidence={confidence} source={source_name} required={required}')
                else:
                    elapsed = max(0.0, now - float(pending['mono']))
                    expected = float(pending['value']) + (elapsed if status == 'playing' else 0.0)
                    duration_ok = (not duration or not pending.get('duration') or
                                   abs(float(duration) - float(pending.get('duration'))) <= 2500)
                    source_ok = (not pending.get('source_key') or not source_key or pending.get('source_key') == source_key)
                    coherent = duration_ok and source_ok and abs(observed - expected) <= 2400
                    if coherent:
                        count = int(pending.get('count', 1)) + 1
                        required = max(int(pending.get('required', 2)), 2)
                        if count >= required:
                            chosen = observed
                            self._uia_has_lock = True
                            self._uia_provisional = False
                            self._uia_provisional_started_mono = None
                            self._uia_locked_source_key = source_key
                            self._uia_locked_source_name = source_name
                            self._uia_initial_pending = None
                            self._uia_pending_far = None
                            self._uia_reacquire_count = 0
                            self._sync_diag(source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                                            raw='UIA', estimated=int(chosen), last=None, age=None,
                                            end=duration, mode='uia-initial-lock',
                                            reason=f'coherent={count}/{required} source={source_name}')
                        else:
                            self._uia_initial_pending = {
                                'value': observed, 'mono': now, 'duration': duration, 'count': count,
                                'required': required, 'source_key': source_key, 'source_name': source_name
                            }
                    else:
                        required = 2
                        self._uia_initial_pending = {
                            'value': observed, 'mono': now, 'duration': duration, 'count': 1,
                            'required': required, 'source_key': source_key, 'source_name': source_name
                        }
                        self._sync_diag(source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                                        raw='UIA?', estimated=None, last=None, age=None,
                                        end=duration, mode='uia-initial-reject',
                                        reason=f'incoherent delta={int(observed-expected)}ms source_ok={source_ok} source={source_name}')
            else:
                continuous = gap_ms is not None and gap_ms <= 2200
                trusted_clock_sources = {
                    'uia-preferred-control', 'uia-fast-button', 'uia-point-probe',
                    'uia-saved-locator', 'uia-slider', 'uia-slider-point', 'uia-compact-time', 'kugou-compact-time', 'kugou-slider-point', 'kugou-win32-time', 'kugou-win32-time-pair', 'kugou-win32-trackbar', 'kugou-msaa-time-pair', 'kugou-memory-time-pair', 'kugou-numeric-memory-cs', 'gsmtc-kugou-precise', 'qq-time-pair-validated'
                }
                qq_quantized_clock = (source_name == 'qq-time-pair-validated')
                source_is_strong = source_name in trusted_clock_sources and int(ui.get('confidence') or 0) >= 145
                if (
                    SYNC_AUTHORITY_ENABLED and qq_quantized_clock and
                    not (qq_clock_calibration_trusted or qq_gesture_armed or qq_pending_gesture)
                ):
                    source_is_strong = False
                if source_is_strong:
                    self._uia_last_strong_seen_mono = now
                locked_is_strong = self._uia_locked_source_name in trusted_clock_sources
                # Chromium may recreate the moving time Button after a seek, changing runtime_id/geometry.
                # Treat all verified compact time controls as the same semantic clock family.
                same_clock_family = (
                    source_name == self._uia_locked_source_name or
                    (source_is_strong and locked_is_strong)
                )
                source_changed = bool(
                    self._uia_locked_source_key and source_key and
                    source_key != self._uia_locked_source_key and not same_clock_family
                )
                doc_clock = (source_name == 'uia-doc-point')
                stream_seek = False
                prev_raw_name = str(self._uia_last_observed_source_name or '')
                prev_raw_key = str(self._uia_last_observed_source_key or '')
                prev_raw_strong = prev_raw_name in trusted_clock_sources
                stream_source_coherent = bool(
                    (source_key and prev_raw_key and source_key == prev_raw_key) or
                    (source_name and prev_raw_name and source_name == prev_raw_name) or
                    (source_is_strong and prev_raw_strong)
                )
                if (
                    status == 'playing' and continuous and not source_changed and not doc_clock and
                    self._uia_last_observed_ms is not None and stream_source_coherent
                ):
                    expected_obs = float(self._uia_last_observed_ms)
                    if prev_ui_status == 'playing':
                        expected_obs += gap_ms
                    stream_seek_threshold = 9000.0 if qq_quantized_clock else 7000.0
                    stream_seek = abs(observed - expected_obs) >= stream_seek_threshold

                self._uia_has_lock = True
                if chosen is None:
                    chosen = observed
                    if not self._uia_locked_source_key:
                        self._uia_locked_source_key = source_key
                        self._uia_locked_source_name = source_name
                    self._uia_reacquire_count = 0
                    self._uia_pending_far = None
                else:
                    delta = observed - float(chosen)

                    provisional_resume_reanchor = (
                        self._uia_provisional and
                        prev_ui_status == 'paused' and status == 'playing' and
                        source_name == 'uia-doc-point' and
                        gap_ms is not None and gap_ms <= 4000 and
                        abs(delta) >= 5000
                    )
                    if qq_quantized_clock and self._qq_seek_pending is not None:
                        chosen, _ = self._qq_queue_seek(
                            process_name, status, observed, source_name, source_key,
                            int(ui.get('confidence') or 0), duration, chosen, now,
                            reason=f'pending-followup delta={int(delta)}ms',
                            gesture_armed=qq_gesture_armed
                        )
                    elif provisional_resume_reanchor:
                        # 暂停态的 Document 帧可能滞后；播放恢复后的第一帧若明显不同，
                        # 先立即重锚，但仍保持 provisional，等待后续样本/强控件正式确认。
                        chosen = observed
                        self._uia_provisional_started_mono = now
                        self._uia_initial_pending = {
                            'value': observed, 'mono': now, 'duration': duration, 'count': 1,
                            'required': 2, 'source_key': source_key, 'source_name': source_name
                        }
                        self._uia_pending_far = None
                        self._uia_reacquire_count = 0
                        self._sync_diag(
                            source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                            raw='UIA~', estimated=int(chosen), last=None, age=None,
                            end=duration, mode='uia-provisional-resume-reanchor',
                            reason=f'post-resume delta={int(delta)}ms source={source_name}'
                        )
                    elif stream_seek:
                        if qq_quantized_clock:
                            chosen, _ = self._qq_queue_seek(
                                process_name, status, observed, source_name, source_key,
                                int(ui.get('confidence') or 0), duration, chosen, now,
                                reason=f'continuous-stream delta={int(delta)}ms',
                                gesture_armed=qq_gesture_armed
                            )
                        else:
                            chosen = observed
                            accepted_seek_this_sample = True
                            self._mark_seek_burst(
                                observed, source_name, now,
                                suppress_serial=self._visual_seek_matches(observed, now, tolerance_ms=3200.0)
                            )
                            self._clear_visual_seek_override()
                            self._uia_provisional = False
                            self._uia_provisional_started_mono = None
                            self._uia_reacquire_count = 0
                            self._uia_pending_far = None
                            self._sync_diag(source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                                            raw='UIA', estimated=int(chosen), last=None, age=None,
                                            end=duration, mode='uia-confirmed-seek',
                                            reason=f'continuous-stream delta={int(delta)}ms')
                    elif (
                        qq_quantized_clock and status == 'playing' and
                        abs(delta) >= (1200.0 if SYNC_AUTHORITY_ENABLED else 2500.0) and
                        (qq_gesture_armed or qq_pending_gesture)
                    ):
                        chosen, _ = self._qq_queue_seek(
                            process_name, status, observed, source_name, source_key,
                            int(ui.get('confidence') or 0), duration, chosen, now,
                            reason=f'gesture delta={int(delta)}ms',
                            gesture_armed=qq_gesture_armed
                        )
                    elif (
                        qq_quantized_clock and status == 'playing' and
                        abs(delta) < 9000.0 and not SYNC_AUTHORITY_ENABLED
                    ):
                        # v1.8.9.2 compatibility path.
                        if abs(delta) >= 1200.0:
                            correction = max(-280.0, min(280.0, delta * 0.18))
                            chosen = float(chosen) + correction
                            self._sync_diag(
                                source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                                raw='UIA~', estimated=int(chosen), last=None, age=None,
                                end=duration, mode='qq-clock-soft-correct',
                                reason=f'delta={int(delta)}ms correction={int(correction)}ms'
                            )
                        self._playing_seek_pending = None
                        self._uia_pending_far = None
                        self._uia_reacquire_count = 0
                    elif abs(delta) < (2600.0 if (qq_quantized_clock and status == 'paused') else
                                            3800.0 if qq_quantized_clock else 2200.0):
                        if doc_clock and status in ('playing', 'paused'):
                            self._uia_last_good_doc_mono = now
                        # QQ 的当前时间是整秒文本，不用它持续“掰回”本地毫秒时钟。
                        # 网易云等精细来源仍保留原来的轻微 15% 校准。
                        if status == 'paused':
                            self._paused_seek_pending = None
                        elif status == 'playing':
                            self._playing_seek_pending = None
                        if qq_quantized_clock and SYNC_AUTHORITY_ENABLED:
                            # QQ exposes only mm:ss. The public local millisecond clock must
                            # stay continuous, but v43 was too conservative here: when it
                            # drifted 0.5~1.4s behind the already-validated QQ time bucket,
                            # it could remain late until a later seek happened to re-anchor it.
                            #
                            # v44 uses an asymmetric phase lock. Trusted ordinary-playback
                            # samples may pull a late local clock forward promptly; an ahead
                            # clock is corrected only very gently so glyphs never visibly rewind.
                            phase_error = float(observed) - float(chosen)  # observed already includes +420ms bucket phase
                            # v97: calibrate only on real +1s accessibility edges. Repeated
                            # whole-second values are bucket samples, not independent clock
                            # measurements; steering on every repeat was the main remaining QQ
                            # phase sawtooth. The PLL first learns this client/machine's UIA
                            # publication baseline, then corrects only drift away from it.
                            _seek_commit = float(self._qq_seek_last_commit_mono or 0.0)
                            _seek_age = (now - _seek_commit) if _seek_commit > 0.0 else None
                            _phase_baseline = getattr(self, '_qq_phase_edge_baseline_ms', None)
                            fast_seek_edge_probe = bool(
                                QQ_POST_SEEK_FAST_EDGE_REPHASE_ENABLED and status == 'playing' and
                                _phase_baseline is not None and _seek_age is not None and
                                float(QQ_POST_SEEK_FAST_EDGE_REPHASE_MIN_AGE_MS) <= _seek_age <=
                                    float(QQ_POST_SEEK_FAST_EDGE_REPHASE_WINDOW_MS) and
                                float(getattr(self, '_qq_post_seek_hard_rephase_done_mono', 0.0) or 0.0) < _seek_commit
                            )
                            # A confirmed same-track seek preserves the already-learned UIA edge
                            # publication baseline. Let the first genuine +1s post-seek edge be
                            # measured against it even before the normal 3-sample trust gate.
                            edge_correction, edge_info = self._qq_phase_edge_correction(
                                observed, chosen, source_key, now,
                                bool(qq_clock_calibration_trusted or fast_seek_edge_probe)
                            )
                            if qq_clock_calibration_trusted and abs(float(edge_correction or 0.0)) >= 0.5:
                                chosen = float(chosen) + float(edge_correction)
                                phase_error = float(observed) - float(chosen)
                                self._qq_clock_last_calibrate_mono = now
                                try:
                                    self._sync_diag(
                                        source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                                        raw='UIA~', estimated=int(chosen), last=None, age=None,
                                        end=duration, mode='qq-clock-edge-pll',
                                        reason=(
                                            f'correction={int(edge_correction)}ms corridor={int((edge_info or {}).get("corridor_delta", 0))}ms residual={int((edge_info or {}).get("residual", 0))}ms '
                                            f'baseline={int((edge_info or {}).get("baseline", 0) or 0)}ms '
                                            f'samples={int((edge_info or {}).get("samples", 0) or 0)}'
                                        )
                                    )
                                except Exception:
                                    pass
                            hard_rephased = False
                            if fast_seek_edge_probe and edge_info:
                                try:
                                    residual = float((edge_info or {}).get('residual', 0.0) or 0.0)
                                    corridor_delta = float((edge_info or {}).get('corridor_delta', 0.0) or 0.0)
                                    edge_quality = bool((edge_info or {}).get('quality', False))
                                    if (
                                        edge_quality and
                                        float(QQ_POST_SEEK_CORRIDOR_MIN_ERROR_MS) <= abs(corridor_delta) <=
                                            float(QQ_POST_SEEK_FAST_EDGE_REPHASE_MAX_ERROR_MS)
                                    ):
                                        raw_correction = corridor_delta * float(QQ_POST_SEEK_FAST_EDGE_REPHASE_FRACTION)
                                        if raw_correction > 0.0:
                                            correction = min(float(QQ_POST_SEEK_FAST_EDGE_REPHASE_MAX_CORRECTION_MS), max(220.0, raw_correction))
                                        else:
                                            correction = max(-float(QQ_POST_SEEK_FAST_EDGE_REPHASE_MAX_CORRECTION_MS), min(-220.0, raw_correction))
                                        chosen = float(chosen) + correction
                                        phase_error = float(observed) - float(chosen)
                                        self._qq_clock_last_calibrate_mono = now
                                        self._qq_post_seek_hard_rephase_done_mono = _seek_commit
                                        hard_rephased = True
                                        self._sync_diag(
                                            source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                                            raw='UIA~', estimated=int(chosen), last=None, age=None,
                                            end=duration, mode='qq-post-seek-fast-edge-rephase',
                                            reason=(
                                                f'seek_age={int(_seek_age or 0)}ms corridor={int(corridor_delta)}ms residual={int(residual)}ms '
                                                f'baseline={int(float((edge_info or {}).get("baseline", 0) or 0))}ms '
                                                f'phase_error={int(phase_error)}ms correction={int(correction)}ms'
                                            )
                                        )
                                except Exception:
                                    pass
                            if (
                                QQ_POST_SEEK_HARD_REPHASE_ENABLED and status == 'playing' and
                                qq_clock_calibration_trusted and self._qq_clock_good_streak >= 3 and
                                float(self._qq_seek_last_commit_mono or 0.0) > 0.0 and
                                float(getattr(self, '_qq_post_seek_hard_rephase_done_mono', 0.0) or 0.0) <
                                    float(self._qq_seek_last_commit_mono or 0.0)
                            ):
                                seek_age = now - float(self._qq_seek_last_commit_mono or 0.0)
                                commit_target = self._qq_seek_last_commit_target
                                post = [
                                    (float(m), float(p)) for m, p in list(getattr(self, '_qq_seek_phase_samples', []) or [])
                                    if float(m) >= float(self._qq_seek_last_commit_mono or 0.0)
                                ]
                                sample_span = (post[-1][0] - post[0][0]) if len(post) >= 2 else 0.0
                                progressed = bool(
                                    commit_target is not None and
                                    float(observed) - float(commit_target) >= 500.0
                                )
                                edge_corridor_delta = float((edge_info or {}).get('corridor_delta', 0.0) or 0.0)
                                edge_quality = bool((edge_info or {}).get('valid', False) and (edge_info or {}).get('quality', False))
                                stable_phase_error = edge_corridor_delta
                                if (
                                    edge_quality and
                                    float(QQ_POST_SEEK_HARD_REPHASE_MIN_AGE_MS) <= seek_age <=
                                        float(QQ_POST_SEEK_HARD_REPHASE_WINDOW_MS) and
                                    sample_span >= float(QQ_POST_SEEK_HARD_REPHASE_MIN_SAMPLE_SPAN_MS) and
                                    progressed and
                                    float(QQ_POST_SEEK_CORRIDOR_MIN_ERROR_MS) <= abs(stable_phase_error) <=
                                        float(QQ_POST_SEEK_HARD_REPHASE_MAX_ERROR_MS)
                                ):
                                    raw_correction = stable_phase_error * float(QQ_POST_SEEK_HARD_REPHASE_FRACTION)
                                    if raw_correction > 0.0:
                                        correction = min(float(QQ_POST_SEEK_HARD_REPHASE_MAX_CORRECTION_MS), max(240.0, raw_correction))
                                    else:
                                        correction = max(-float(QQ_POST_SEEK_HARD_REPHASE_MAX_CORRECTION_MS), min(-240.0, raw_correction))
                                    chosen = float(chosen) + correction
                                    self._qq_clock_last_calibrate_mono = now
                                    self._qq_post_seek_hard_rephase_done_mono = float(self._qq_seek_last_commit_mono or now)
                                    hard_rephased = True
                                    self._sync_diag(
                                        source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                                        raw='UIA~', estimated=int(chosen), last=None, age=None,
                                        end=duration, mode='qq-post-seek-hard-rephase',
                                        reason=(
                                            f'streak={self._qq_clock_good_streak} seek_age={int(seek_age)}ms '
                                            f'phase_error={int(phase_error)}ms corridor={int(edge_corridor_delta)}ms stable={int(stable_phase_error)}ms '
                                            f'correction={int(correction)}ms samples={len(post)} span={int(sample_span)}ms'
                                        )
                                    )
                            if QQ_CLOCK_PHASE_RELOCK_ENABLED and not QQ_PHASE_EDGE_PLL_ENABLED and status == 'playing' and qq_clock_calibration_trusted and not hard_rephased:
                                forward = phase_error >= 220.0
                                backward = phase_error <= -950.0
                                min_gap = 360.0 if forward else 1600.0
                                if (
                                    (forward or backward) and
                                    self._qq_clock_good_streak >= 3 and
                                    (now - float(self._qq_clock_last_calibrate_mono or 0.0)) >= min_gap
                                ):
                                    if forward:
                                        correction = max(28.0, min(220.0, phase_error * 0.34))
                                    else:
                                        correction = max(-45.0, min(-18.0, phase_error * 0.06))
                                    chosen = float(chosen) + correction
                                    self._qq_clock_last_calibrate_mono = now
                                    self._sync_diag(
                                        source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                                        raw='UIA~', estimated=int(chosen), last=None, age=None,
                                        end=duration, mode='qq-clock-phase-relock',
                                        reason=(
                                            f'streak={self._qq_clock_good_streak} phase_error={int(phase_error)}ms '
                                            f'correction={int(correction)}ms '
                                            f'direction={"forward" if correction > 0 else "backward"} '
                                            f'phase_samples={len(getattr(self, "_qq_seek_phase_samples", []) or [])}'
                                        )
                                    )
                            elif (not PHASE_SEEK_FIX_ENABLED) and (not QQ_PHASE_EDGE_PLL_ENABLED):
                                # Legacy A/B mode keeps the historical broad bucket behavior.
                                display_floor = float(observed) - 420.0
                                bucket_low = display_floor - 140.0
                                bucket_high = display_floor + 1140.0
                                if float(chosen) < bucket_low:
                                    bucket_delta = bucket_low - float(chosen)
                                elif float(chosen) > bucket_high:
                                    bucket_delta = bucket_high - float(chosen)
                                else:
                                    bucket_delta = 0.0
                                if abs(bucket_delta) >= 450.0:
                                    correction = max(-110.0, min(110.0, bucket_delta * 0.10))
                                    chosen = float(chosen) + correction
                                    self._sync_diag(
                                        source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                                        raw='UIA~', estimated=int(chosen), last=None, age=None,
                                        end=duration, mode='qq-clock-trusted-calibrate',
                                        reason=f'bucket_delta={int(bucket_delta)}ms correction={int(correction)}ms'
                                    )
                        elif (not qq_quantized_clock) and abs(delta) >= 700:
                            chosen = float(chosen) + delta * 0.15
                        # provisional Document 只要得到第二个自然连续样本，或出现强控件且与
                        # 当前时钟一致，就正式确认；字幕从第一样本起已经在显示，不再空等。
                        if self._uia_provisional and (
                            source_is_strong or
                            (source_name == self._uia_locked_source_name and source_key == self._uia_locked_source_key)
                        ):
                            self._uia_provisional = False
                            self._uia_provisional_started_mono = None
                            confirmed_clock_this_sample = True
                            self._sync_diag(source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                                            raw='UIA', estimated=int(chosen), last=None, age=None,
                                            end=duration, mode='uia-provisional-confirmed',
                                            reason=f'source={source_name} delta={int(delta)}ms')
                        # 如果冷启动先靠 Document 锁定，之后出现真正的小型时间控件，
                        # 在它与当前时钟一致时直接升级主时钟身份。
                        if source_is_strong:
                            self._uia_locked_source_key = source_key
                            self._uia_locked_source_name = source_name
                        self._uia_reacquire_count = 0
                        self._uia_pending_far = None
                    else:
                        confidence = int(ui.get('confidence') or 0)
                        source_name = str(ui.get('source') or '')
                        strong_seek_source = (
                            confidence >= 145 and source_name in trusted_clock_sources
                        )

                        # 已经同步后，真实小型时间控件出现明显偏移时立即接管。
                        # 不再要求 runtime_id/geometry 必须与 seek 前完全相同；Chromium 常会重建移动 Button。
                        qq_fast_seek_allowed = (
                            (not qq_quantized_clock) or abs(delta) >= 9000.0
                        )
                        if (strong_seek_source and qq_fast_seek_allowed and status == 'playing' and
                                gap_ms is not None and gap_ms <= 5000):
                            if qq_quantized_clock:
                                chosen, _ = self._qq_queue_seek(
                                    process_name, status, observed, source_name, source_key,
                                    confidence, duration, chosen, now,
                                    reason=f'fast-source gap={int(gap_ms)}ms delta={int(delta)}ms',
                                    gesture_armed=qq_gesture_armed
                                )
                            else:
                                chosen = observed
                                accepted_seek_this_sample = True
                                self._mark_seek_burst(
                                    observed, source_name, now,
                                    suppress_serial=self._visual_seek_matches(observed, now, tolerance_ms=3200.0)
                                )
                                self._clear_visual_seek_override()
                                self._playing_seek_pending = None
                                self._uia_provisional = False
                                self._uia_provisional_started_mono = None
                                self._uia_reacquire_count = 0
                                self._uia_pending_far = None
                                self._sync_diag(source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                                                raw='UIA', estimated=int(chosen), last=None, age=None,
                                                end=duration, mode='uia-fast-seek',
                                                reason=f'strong-source gap={int(gap_ms)}ms delta={int(delta)}ms')
                        elif qq_quantized_clock and status == 'playing' and abs(delta) < 9000.0:
                            # QQ 2.6~6 秒的单帧差异不直接当 seek。保持本地连续时钟；
                            # 若它是真实 seek，下一批 raw 样本会触发 stream_seek / watchdog 二次确认。
                            self._uia_pending_far = None
                            self._uia_reacquire_count = 0
                            self._sync_diag(
                                source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                                raw='UIA~', estimated=None if chosen is None else int(chosen),
                                last=None, age=None, end=duration, mode='qq-quantized-drift-hold',
                                reason=f'delta={int(delta)}ms source={source_name}'
                            )
                        else:
                            if status == 'paused':
                                paused_doc_source = (source_name == 'uia-doc-point' and confidence >= 110)
                                paused_source_allowed = strong_seek_source or paused_doc_source

                                qq_paused_direct = (
                                    (not qq_quantized_clock) or
                                    abs(delta) >= (1200.0 if SYNC_AUTHORITY_ENABLED else 4000.0)
                                )
                                if strong_seek_source and qq_paused_direct:
                                    if qq_quantized_clock:
                                        chosen, _ = self._qq_queue_seek(
                                            process_name, status, observed, source_name, source_key,
                                            confidence, duration, chosen, now,
                                            reason=f'paused-target delta={int(delta)}ms',
                                            gesture_armed=qq_gesture_armed
                                        )
                                    else:
                                        chosen = observed
                                        accepted_seek_this_sample = True
                                        self._mark_seek_burst(
                                            observed, source_name, now,
                                            suppress_serial=self._visual_seek_matches(observed, now, tolerance_ms=3200.0)
                                        )
                                        self._clear_visual_seek_override()
                                        self._paused_seek_pending = None
                                        self._uia_pending_far = None
                                        self._uia_reacquire_count = 0
                                        self._uia_provisional = False
                                        self._uia_provisional_started_mono = None
                                        self._uia_locked_source_key = source_key
                                        self._uia_locked_source_name = source_name
                                        self._sync_diag(
                                            source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                                            raw='UIA', estimated=int(chosen), last=None, age=None,
                                            end=duration, mode='uia-paused-seek-fast',
                                            reason=f'strong-source target={int(observed)}ms'
                                        )
                                elif qq_quantized_clock and strong_seek_source:
                                    self._sync_diag(
                                        source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                                        raw='UIA~', estimated=None if chosen is None else int(chosen),
                                        last=None, age=None, end=duration, mode='qq-paused-quantized-hold',
                                        reason=f'delta={int(delta)}ms'
                                    )
                                elif paused_doc_source:
                                    # Document 点命中通过总时长校验后可参与暂停 seek，
                                    # 但做短 debounce：连续点击/拖动时始终只取最后位置。
                                    p = self._paused_seek_pending
                                    if p is None or p.get('source_name') != 'uia-doc-point':
                                        p = {
                                            'value': observed,
                                            'first_seen_mono': now,
                                            'last_change_mono': now,
                                            'source_key': source_key,
                                            'source_name': source_name,
                                            'confidence': confidence,
                                            'duration': duration,
                                        }
                                    else:
                                        old_value = float(p.get('value', observed))
                                        if abs(observed - old_value) >= 650:
                                            p['last_change_mono'] = now
                                        p['value'] = observed
                                        p['source_key'] = source_key
                                        p['confidence'] = confidence
                                        p['duration'] = duration
                                    self._paused_seek_pending = p
                                    self._uia_pending_far = None
                                    self._uia_reacquire_count = 0
                                    try:
                                        self._uia_reader.request_urgent_scan(1.4)
                                    except Exception:
                                        pass
                                    self._sync_diag(
                                        source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                                        raw='UIA?', estimated=None if chosen is None else int(chosen),
                                        last=None, age=None, end=duration, mode='uia-paused-seek-pending',
                                        reason=f'target={int(observed)}ms settle={int(self._paused_seek_settle_ms)}ms'
                                    )
                                else:
                                    # 整页 combined-text/time-pair 可能把歌词页中的别的时间误认成播放位置。
                                    # 它们可以用于一般诊断，但绝不参与暂停点击 seek。
                                    self._sync_diag(
                                        source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                                        raw='UIA?', estimated=None if chosen is None else int(chosen),
                                        last=None, age=None, end=duration, mode='uia-paused-seek-ignore',
                                        reason=f'untrusted-source={source_name} confidence={confidence}'
                                    )
                            else:
                                playing_doc_source = (
                                    status == 'playing' and
                                    source_name == 'uia-doc-point' and confidence >= 110
                                )
                                strong_recent = (
                                    self._uia_last_strong_seen_mono is not None and
                                    (now - float(self._uia_last_strong_seen_mono)) <= 1600.0
                                )
                                if playing_doc_source:
                                    recent_good_doc = bool(
                                        getattr(self, '_uia_last_good_doc_mono', None) is not None and
                                        (now - float(self._uia_last_good_doc_mono)) <= 8000.0
                                    )
                                    same_locked_doc_for_visual = bool(
                                        PHASE_SEEK_FIX_ENABLED and
                                        source_key and source_key == 'doc:cloudmusic' and
                                        not self._uia_provisional and abs(delta) >= 5000.0 and
                                        (
                                            self._uia_locked_source_name == 'uia-doc-point' or
                                            recent_good_doc
                                        )
                                    )
                                    if same_locked_doc_for_visual:
                                        self._set_visual_seek_override(
                                            observed, source_name, now, ttl_ms=1500.0,
                                            preserve_live=True, status=status
                                        )
                                        self._sync_diag(
                                            source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                                            raw='UIA>', estimated=int(observed), last=None, age=None,
                                            end=duration, mode='uia-playing-seek-visual-follow',
                                            reason=f'target={int(observed)}ms delta={int(delta)}ms locked-doc=1'
                                        )
                                    # 弱 doc-point 永远保留候选。最近见过强源时，只给强源约 360ms 优先权；
                                    # 强源没回来就采用 doc 目标，不再丢掉第一次点击。
                                    p = self._playing_seek_pending
                                    if p is None:
                                        p = {
                                            'value': observed,
                                            'first_seen_mono': now,
                                            'last_change_mono': now,
                                            'last_sample_mono': now,
                                            'stable_samples': 1,
                                            'samples': 1,
                                            'source_key': source_key,
                                            'source_name': source_name,
                                            'confidence': confidence,
                                            'duration': duration,
                                            'prefer_strong_until_mono': now + (360.0 if strong_recent else 0.0),
                                        }
                                    else:
                                        old_value = float(p.get('value', observed))
                                        last_sample = float(p.get('last_sample_mono', now))
                                        elapsed = max(0.0, now - last_sample)
                                        raw_step = float(observed) - old_value

                                        # A real settled playback clock should either repeat,
                                        # or move forward roughly with elapsed time. Large
                                        # backwards/forwards changes are still slider motion.
                                        natural_progress = (
                                            -350.0 <= raw_step <= max(1500.0, elapsed + 1400.0)
                                        )
                                        if natural_progress:
                                            p['stable_samples'] = int(p.get('stable_samples', 1)) + 1
                                        else:
                                            p['last_change_mono'] = now
                                            p['stable_samples'] = 1

                                        p['value'] = observed
                                        p['last_sample_mono'] = now
                                        p['samples'] = int(p.get('samples', 1)) + 1
                                        p['source_key'] = source_key
                                        p['confidence'] = confidence
                                        p['duration'] = duration
                                        if strong_recent:
                                            p['prefer_strong_until_mono'] = max(
                                                float(p.get('prefer_strong_until_mono', 0.0) or 0.0),
                                                now + 360.0
                                            )
                                    self._playing_seek_pending = p
                                    self._uia_pending_far = None
                                    self._uia_reacquire_count = 0
                                    try:
                                        self._uia_reader.request_urgent_scan(1.2)
                                    except Exception:
                                        pass
                                    mode = 'uia-playing-seek-prefer-strong' if strong_recent else 'uia-playing-seek-pending'
                                    self._sync_diag(
                                        source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                                        raw='UIA?', estimated=None if chosen is None else int(chosen),
                                        last=None, age=None, end=duration,
                                        mode=mode,
                                        reason=(
                                            f'target={int(observed)}ms '
                                            f'settle={int(self._playing_seek_settle_ms)}ms '
                                            f'stable={int(p.get("stable_samples", 1))} '
                                            f'strong_recent={int(strong_recent)}'
                                        )
                                    )
                                else:
                                    # combined-text/time-pair 等整页弱来源不再负责 seek。
                                    self._uia_pending_far = None
                                    self._uia_reacquire_count = 0
                                    self._sync_diag(
                                        source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                                        raw='UIA?', estimated=None if chosen is None else int(chosen),
                                        last=None, age=None, end=duration,
                                        mode='uia-playing-seek-ignore',
                                        reason=f'untrusted-source={source_name} confidence={confidence}'
                                    )

            self._uia_last_seen_mono = now
            self._uia_last_observed_ms = observed
            self._uia_last_observed_source_name = source_name
            self._uia_last_observed_source_key = source_key

            # seek 后主动复核。正常目标保持不动；明显脱离时优先由强控件，
            # 或两个连续弱 doc 样本快速拉回。
            chosen, watchdog_corrected = self._seek_watchdog_correct(
                process_name, status, observed, source_name, source_key,
                int(ui.get('confidence') or 0), duration, chosen, now
            )
            if watchdog_corrected:
                accepted_seek_this_sample = True

        # QQ 必须看到同一条目标时间流至少两个连续样本后才提交。
        chosen, qq_seek_committed = self._qq_commit_seek_if_ready(
            process_name, status, chosen, now
        )
        if qq_seek_committed:
            accepted_seek_this_sample = True

        # 暂停 seek debounce：doc-point 停手约 0.45 秒后采用最后目标。
        # 强控件在上面已经直接提交。任何未成熟候选一旦恢复播放就立即清除，
        # 绝不允许跨一次播放阶段残留到下一次暂停。
        paused_pending = self._paused_seek_pending
        if paused_pending is not None:
            last_change = float(paused_pending.get('last_change_mono', now))
            first_seen = float(paused_pending.get('first_seen_mono', last_change))
            settle_age = max(0.0, now - last_change)
            total_age = max(0.0, now - first_seen)
            source_ok = paused_pending.get('source_name') == 'uia-doc-point'

            paused_required_ms = 110.0 if self._seek_burst_active(now) else float(self._paused_seek_settle_ms)
            should_commit_paused = (
                status == 'paused' and source_ok and
                settle_age >= paused_required_ms
            )
            should_commit_on_resume = (
                status == 'playing' and prev_ui_status == 'paused' and source_ok
            )

            if should_commit_paused or should_commit_on_resume:
                candidate = float(paused_pending.get('value', chosen if chosen is not None else 0.0))
                chosen = candidate
                accepted_seek_this_sample = True
                self._mark_seek_burst(
                    candidate, paused_pending.get('source_name'), now,
                    suppress_serial=self._visual_seek_matches(candidate, now, tolerance_ms=3200.0)
                )
                self._clear_visual_seek_override()
                self._uia_provisional = False
                self._uia_provisional_started_mono = None
                self._uia_locked_source_key = paused_pending.get('source_key') or self._uia_locked_source_key
                self._uia_locked_source_name = paused_pending.get('source_name') or self._uia_locked_source_name
                self._paused_seek_pending = None
                self._uia_pending_far = None
                self._uia_reacquire_count = 0
                mode = 'uia-paused-seek-settled' if status == 'paused' else 'uia-paused-seek-resume-commit'
                self._sync_diag(
                    source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                    raw='UIA', estimated=int(candidate), last=None, age=None,
                    end=paused_pending.get('duration') or duration, mode=mode,
                    reason=f'target={int(candidate)}ms settle_age={int(settle_age)}ms total_age={int(total_age)}ms'
                )
            elif status == 'playing':
                # 未成熟的点击候选到恢复播放时就作废，避免下一次暂停才突然跳过去。
                self._sync_diag(
                    source=process_name, status=status, prev=self._est_status,
                    raw='UIA?', estimated=None if chosen is None else int(chosen),
                    last=None, age=None, end=paused_pending.get('duration') or duration,
                    mode='uia-paused-seek-cancel-on-resume',
                    reason=f'age={int(total_age)}ms source={paused_pending.get("source_name")}'
                )
                self._paused_seek_pending = None
            elif status != 'paused':
                self._paused_seek_pending = None

        # 播放中 doc-point seek：
        # 单个 UIA 样本不能再靠定时器自己落地。至少需要第二个新的、轨迹合理
        # 的 doc-point 样本，避免连续拖动中的每个中间点都被当成最终位置。
        # 如果用户 seek 后立即暂停，则仍保留旧行为：暂停状态可以采用最后候选。
        playing_pending = self._playing_seek_pending
        if playing_pending is not None:
            last_change = float(playing_pending.get('last_change_mono', now))
            first_seen = float(playing_pending.get('first_seen_mono', last_change))
            last_sample = float(playing_pending.get('last_sample_mono', first_seen))
            total_age = max(0.0, now - first_seen)
            settle_age = max(0.0, now - last_change)
            sample_age = max(0.0, now - last_sample)
            stable_samples = int(playing_pending.get('stable_samples', 1))
            sample_count = int(playing_pending.get('samples', stable_samples))
            source_ok = playing_pending.get('source_name') == 'uia-doc-point'
            netease_click_recent = now <= float(self._netease_page_interaction_until_mono or 0.0)
            playing_required_ms = (
                90.0 if self._seek_burst_active(now) else
                (110.0 if netease_click_recent else float(self._playing_seek_settle_ms))
            )
            prefer_strong_until = float(playing_pending.get('prefer_strong_until_mono', 0.0) or 0.0)
            strong_priority_done = now >= prefer_strong_until
            fresh_sample = sample_age <= 850.0
            provisional_age = (
                0.0 if self._uia_provisional_started_mono is None
                else max(0.0, now - float(self._uia_provisional_started_mono))
            )
            same_locked_doc = bool(
                source_ok and
                self._uia_locked_source_name == 'uia-doc-point' and
                playing_pending.get('source_key') and
                playing_pending.get('source_key') == self._uia_locked_source_key and
                (not self._uia_provisional or provisional_age >= 5000.0)
            )
            recent_good_doc = bool(
                source_ok and
                getattr(self, '_uia_last_good_doc_mono', None) is not None and
                (now - float(self._uia_last_good_doc_mono)) <= 8000.0 and
                (not self._uia_provisional or provisional_age >= 5000.0)
            )
            # A learned, already-confirmed Document clock occasionally emits only one
            # sample for the *final* target after a burst of intermediate seek positions,
            # then Chromium stalls for several seconds. Earlier v1.8.9.2 required the
            # whole pending session to contain exactly one sample, so rapid multi-jump
            # sessions could still lose their final target. Quiet time is already measured
            # from the last target change, therefore earlier intermediate samples are safe
            # to retain while the final one-sample target settles.
            single_sample_locked_fallback = bool(
