                fading.glow = lw.glow
                fading.glow_color = QColor(lw.glow_color)
                fading.glow_size = lw.glow_size
                fading.glow_alpha = lw.glow_alpha
            lw.update()
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _set_glow_enabled(self, enabled):
        self._apply_glow_live(); self._schedule_config_save()

    def _set_control_panel_topmost(self, enabled):
        """Only toggle the control panel. LyricWindow keeps its independent topmost flag."""
        try:
            was_visible = self.isVisible()
            geom = self.geometry()
            self.setWindowFlag(Qt.WindowStaysOnTopHint, bool(enabled))
            self.setGeometry(geom)
            if was_visible:
                self.show()
        except Exception as exc:
            write_error_log("切换控制面板置顶失败", exc)

    def _warmup_selected_player(self):
        try:
            player_name = self.player_combo.currentText()
            process_name = self.players.get(player_name, {}).get('process', '')
            if not process_name:
                return
            if player_name != '网易云音乐' and bool(getattr(self, '_zero_touch_armed', False)):
                # Zero-touch is a NetEase-only convenience. A deliberate player switch must
                # return control to the normal manual/auto-track semantics for that player.
                self._zero_touch_armed = False
                self._is_started = False
                self._auto_armed = False
            if NETEASE_ZERO_TOUCH_BOOTSTRAP_ENABLED and player_name == '网易云音乐':
                # Start the listener/GSMTC/UIA fallback before lyrics are fetched. Bridge
                # deployment is filesystem-only and lyric search is metadata/API-only, so
                # neither side depends on the other being ready first.
                self.media_sync.start(process_name)
            else:
                self.media_sync.warmup(process_name)
        except Exception as exc:
            write_error_log("播放器同步预热失败", exc)


    def refresh_player_list(self):
        self.player_combo.blockSignals(True); self.player_combo.clear()
        # 当前前端只开放稳定的三家专项适配。旧自定义播放器配置仍保存在 self.players/配置文件中，
        # 未来重新开放入口时可直接恢复，不在这里删除数据。
        names = [name for name in PLAYER_BUILTIN_ORDER if name in self.players]
        self.player_combo.addItems(names)
        self.player_combo.blockSignals(False)

    def add_custom_player(self):
        name, ok = QInputDialog.getText(self, "自定义播放器", "输入播放器名称：")
        if ok and name.strip():
            name = name.strip()
            if name in self.players: QMessageBox.warning(self, "重复", "该播放器已存在！"); return
            proc, ok2 = QInputDialog.getText(self, "进程名", "输入进程名（如 qqmusic.exe）：")
            if ok2 and proc.strip():
                pattern, ok3 = QInputDialog.getText(
                    self, "标题正则", "输入标题匹配正则：", text=r'^(.+?)\s*-\s*(.+)$')
                if ok3 and pattern.strip():
                    self.players[name] = {
                        "process": proc.strip(), "pattern": pattern.strip(),
                        "adapter": "auto", "schema": 1
                    }
                    self.refresh_player_list(); self.player_combo.setCurrentText(name)
                    self._schedule_config_save()
                    self.status.setText(f"状态：已添加播放器 {name}；可点击“检测”查看标准媒体接口能力")
                    QTimer.singleShot(250, self.probe_selected_player_capabilities)

    def probe_selected_player_capabilities(self):
        """Non-destructive first-stage Custom Player Adapter probe.

        This intentionally probes only the standard MediaSync/GSMTC path. Unknown players
        that expose a healthy Windows media session can therefore become usable without a
        per-player patch. UIA calibration/provider plugins are later adapter layers.
        """
        name = str(self.player_combo.currentText() or '').strip()
        cfg = self.players.get(name, {}) if name else {}
        process_name = str(cfg.get('process') or '').strip()
        if not process_name:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, '播放器能力检测', '当前播放器没有配置进程名。')
            return
        try:
            self.media_sync.start(process_name)
            QApplication.processEvents()
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 0.9
            state = {}
            while time.monotonic() < deadline:
                state = self.media_sync.snapshot() or {}
                media_source = str(state.get('media_source') or '')
                if media_source and self.media_sync._source_matches_process_hint(media_source, process_name):
                    break
                QApplication.processEvents()
                time.sleep(0.04)
            media_source = str(state.get('media_source') or '')
            matched = bool(media_source and self.media_sync._source_matches_process_hint(media_source, process_name))
            title = str(state.get('media_title') or '').strip() if matched else ''
            artist = str(state.get('media_artist') or '').strip() if matched else ''
            status = str(state.get('status') or 'unknown') if matched else 'unknown'
            raw_pos = state.get('raw_position_ms') if matched else None
            est_pos = state.get('position_ms') if matched else None
            duration = state.get('duration_ms') if matched else None
            pos = est_pos if est_pos is not None else raw_pos
            identity_ok = bool(title)
            state_ok = status in ('playing', 'paused')
            position_ok = isinstance(pos, (int, float)) and float(pos) > 0
            duration_ok = isinstance(duration, (int, float)) and float(duration) > 0
            if identity_ok and state_ok and position_ok:
                grade = 'A：可直接作为通用播放器接入（含实时进度/seek 检测）'
                adapter = 'gsmtc'
            elif identity_ok and state_ok:
                grade = 'B：可读取歌曲/播放状态，但缺少可靠进度；下一层需要 UIA/自定义 Provider'
                adapter = 'gsmtc-metadata'
            elif matched:
                grade = 'C：检测到媒体会话，但信息不完整；需要进一步校准'
                adapter = 'auto'
            else:
                grade = 'D：未发现匹配的标准媒体会话；需要 UIA/外部 Bridge/专用 Adapter'
                adapter = 'auto'
            if name not in DEFAULT_PLAYERS and name in self.players:
                self.players[name]['adapter'] = adapter
                self.players[name]['last_probe'] = {
                    'identity': identity_ok, 'state': state_ok, 'position': position_ok,
                    'duration': duration_ok, 'media_source': media_source
                }
                self._schedule_config_save()
            write_error_log('自定义播放器能力检测', detail=(
                f'name={name} | process={process_name} | grade={grade[:1]} | source={media_source or "<none>"} | '
                f'title={title or "<none>"} | artist={artist or "<none>"} | status={status} | '
                f'position={pos} | duration={duration}'
            ))
            QMessageBox.information(
                self, '播放器能力检测',
                f'播放器：{name}\n进程：{process_name}\n\n{grade}\n\n'
                f'歌曲：{title or "未读取"}\n歌手：{artist or "未读取"}\n状态：{status}\n'
                f'位置：{int(pos) if isinstance(pos,(int,float)) else "未读取"} ms\n'
                f'时长：{int(duration) if isinstance(duration,(int,float)) else "未读取"} ms'
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            write_error_log('自定义播放器能力检测失败', exc, detail=f'name={name} | process={process_name}')
            QMessageBox.warning(self, '播放器能力检测', f'检测失败：{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}')

    def delete_player(self):
        name = self.player_combo.currentText()
        if not name: return
        if name in DEFAULT_PLAYERS:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "不能删除", "网易云、QQ音乐、酷狗属于内置播放器，不能删除。")
            return
        if len(self.players) <= 1: QMessageBox.warning(self, "不能删除", "至少保留一个播放器！"); return
        if QMessageBox.question(self, "删除播放器", f"确定删除「{name}」吗？") == QMessageBox.Yes:
            del self.players[name]; self.refresh_player_list()
            self._schedule_config_save()
            self.status.setText(f"状态：已删除播放器 {name}")

    def _restore_window_geometry(self, settings):
        try:
            w = int(settings.get('panel_width', 0) or 0)
            h = int(settings.get('panel_height', 0) or 0)
            x = settings.get('panel_x', None)
            y = settings.get('panel_y', None)
            if w <= 0 or h <= 0 or x is None or y is None:
                return False

            screen = QApplication.primaryScreen().availableGeometry()
            w = max(self.minimumWidth(), min(w, screen.width()))
            h = max(self.minimumHeight(), min(h, screen.height()))
            x = int(x); y = int(y)
            min_visible = 80
            x = min(max(x, screen.left() - w + min_visible), screen.right() - min_visible)
            y = min(max(y, screen.top()), screen.bottom() - min_visible)
            self.resize(w, h)
            self.move(x, y)
            self._geometry_restored = True
            self._restore_maximized = bool(settings.get('panel_maximized', False))
            return True
        except Exception:
            return False

    def fetch_lyric(self):
        # fetch_and_set() pumps Qt events while discovering the player. Without a guard,
        # a double-click can re-enter this synchronous path and start the same fetch twice.
        if bool(getattr(self, '_manual_fetch_in_progress', False)):
            self.status.setText('状态：歌词正在获取中，请勿重复提交')
            try:
                write_error_log('重复手动抓词请求已忽略', detail=f'pid={os.getpid()}')
            except Exception:
                pass
            return
        self._manual_fetch_in_progress = True
        try:
            # “读取歌词”只负责读取；它本身永远不能武装自动字幕。
            self._cancel_auto_jobs(keep_armed=bool(self._is_started and self._auto_armed))
            try:
                write_error_log(
                    '用户请求获取歌词',
                    detail=f'pid={os.getpid()} | is_started={int(self._is_started)} | auto_armed={int(self._auto_armed)}'
                )
            except Exception:
                pass
            LyricFetcher.fetch_and_set(self)
        finally:
            self._manual_fetch_in_progress = False

    def refresh_preset_list(self):
        self.preset_combo.blockSignals(True); self.preset_combo.clear()
        self.preset_combo.addItems(list(self.presets.keys()))
        self.preset_combo.blockSignals(False)

    def _capture_style_preset(self):
        return {
            'text': self.current_color.name(), 'stroke': self.current_stroke_color.name(),
            'shadow': self.current_shadow_color.name(), 'outline_enabled': self.outline_check.isChecked(),
            'glow': self.current_glow_color.name(), 'shadow_enabled': self.shadow_check.isChecked(),
            'glow_enabled': self.glow_check.isChecked(), 'glow_size': self.glow_size_slider.value(),
            'glow_alpha': self.glow_alpha_slider.value(), 'mode': self.mode_combo.currentData(),
            'font_family': self.font_combo.currentFont().family(), 'font_size': self.font_size.value(),
            'stroke_width': self.stroke_spin.value(), 'spacing': self.spacing_spin.value(),
            'shake_intensity': self.shake_intensity_slider.value(), 'shake_speed': self.shake_speed_slider.value(),
            'fade_speed': self.fade_speed_slider.value(), 'rise_speed': self.rise_speed_slider.value(),
            'margin_time': self.margin_spin.value(), 'max_interval': self.max_interval_spin.value(),
            'max_duration': self.max_duration_spin.value(), 'angle_min': self.angle_min.value(),
            'angle_max': self.angle_max.value(), 'perspective_enabled': self.perspective_check.isChecked(),
            'persp_x_strength': self.persp_x_slider.value(), 'persp_y_strength': self.persp_y_slider.value(),
            'persp_compensation': self.persp_comp_slider.value(),
        }

    def new_preset(self):
        name, ok = QInputDialog.getText(self, "新建预设", "输入预设名称：")
        if ok and name.strip():
            name = name.strip()
            if name in self.presets: QMessageBox.warning(self, "重复", "该预设名称已存在！"); return
            self.presets[name] = self._capture_style_preset()
            self.refresh_preset_list(); self.preset_combo.setCurrentText(name)
            self._schedule_config_save()
            self.status.setText(f"状态：已创建完整风格预设 {name}")

    def update_preset(self):
        name = self.preset_combo.currentText().strip()
        if not name: return
        self.presets[name] = self._capture_style_preset()
        self._schedule_config_save()
        self.status.setText(f"状态：已用当前视觉参数更新预设 {name}")

    def rename_preset(self):
        old = self.preset_combo.currentText().strip()
        if not old: return
        new, ok = QInputDialog.getText(self, "重命名预设", "新名称：", text=old)
        if not ok or not new.strip(): return
        new = new.strip()
        if new != old and new in self.presets:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "重复", "该预设名称已存在！"); return
        value = self.presets.pop(old)
        self.presets[new] = value
        self.refresh_preset_list(); self.preset_combo.setCurrentText(new)
        self._schedule_config_save()
        self.status.setText(f"状态：预设已重命名为 {new}")

    def delete_preset(self):
        name = self.preset_combo.currentText()
        if not name: return
        if len(self.presets) <= 1: QMessageBox.warning(self, "不能删除", "至少保留一个预设！"); return
        if QMessageBox.question(self, "删除预设", f"确定删除「{name}」吗？") == QMessageBox.Yes:
            del self.presets[name]; self.refresh_preset_list()
            self._schedule_config_save()
            self.status.setText(f"状态：已删除预设 {name}")

    def pick_glow_color(self):
        c = QColorDialog.getColor(self.current_glow_color, self, "发光外圈颜色")
        if c.isValid():
            self.current_glow_color = c; self.glow_color_btn.setStyleSheet(f"background-color:{c.name()};")
            self._apply_glow_live(); self._schedule_config_save()

    def load_preset(self, name):
        if name in self.presets:
            c = self.presets[name]
            self.current_color = QColor(c.get('text', '#fffeef')); self.current_stroke_color = QColor(c.get('stroke', '#d8a523'))
            self.current_shadow_color = QColor(c.get('shadow', c.get('stroke', '#000000')))
            self.current_glow_color = QColor(c.get('glow', '#ffffff'))
            self.color_btn.setStyleSheet(f"background-color:{self.current_color.name()};")
            self.shadow_btn.setStyleSheet(f"background-color:{self.current_shadow_color.name()};")
            self.stroke_btn.setStyleSheet(f"background-color:{self.current_stroke_color.name()};")
            self.glow_color_btn.setStyleSheet(f"background-color:{self.current_glow_color.name()};")
            # 旧版只有三种颜色的预设也完全兼容；存在扩展字段时才覆盖对应设置。
            mapping = [
                ('shadow_enabled', self.shadow_check, 'check'), ('outline_enabled', self.outline_check, 'check'), ('glow_enabled', self.glow_check, 'check'),
                ('glow_size', self.glow_size_slider, 'value'), ('glow_alpha', self.glow_alpha_slider, 'value'),
                ('font_size', self.font_size, 'value'), ('stroke_width', self.stroke_spin, 'value'),
                ('spacing', self.spacing_spin, 'value'), ('shake_intensity', self.shake_intensity_slider, 'value'),
                ('shake_speed', self.shake_speed_slider, 'value'), ('fade_speed', self.fade_speed_slider, 'value'),
                ('rise_speed', self.rise_speed_slider, 'value'), ('margin_time', self.margin_spin, 'value'),
                ('max_interval', self.max_interval_spin, 'value'), ('max_duration', self.max_duration_spin, 'value'),
                ('angle_min', self.angle_min, 'value'), ('angle_max', self.angle_max, 'value'),
                ('perspective_enabled', self.perspective_check, 'check'),
                ('persp_x_strength', self.persp_x_slider, 'value'), ('persp_y_strength', self.persp_y_slider, 'value'),
                ('persp_compensation', self.persp_comp_slider, 'value'),
            ]
            for key, widget, kind in mapping:
                if key not in c: continue
                try:
                    widget.setChecked(bool(c[key])) if kind == 'check' else widget.setValue(c[key])
                except Exception: pass
            if c.get('font_family'):
                self.font_combo.setCurrentFont(QFont(c['font_family']))
            if c.get('mode'):
                idx = self.mode_combo.findData(c['mode'])
                if idx >= 0: self.mode_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)
            self._schedule_config_save()
            self.status.setText(f"状态：已加载 {name}")
    def auto_select_font(self):
        from PyQt5.QtGui import QFontDatabase
        recommended = ["Mikodacs", "思源黑体 Bold"]
        available = [f for f in recommended if f in QFontDatabase().families()]
        if not available:
            self.status.setText("状态：未找到推荐字体")
            return
        current = self.font_combo.currentFont().family()
        # 找当前字体在列表里的位置，选下一个
        try:
            idx = available.index(current)
            next_idx = (idx + 1) % len(available)
        except ValueError:
            next_idx = 0
        chosen = available[next_idx]
        self.font_combo.setCurrentFont(QFont(chosen))
        self.status.setText(f"状态：已切换字体 {chosen}")
    def pick_color(self):
        c = QColorDialog.getColor(self.current_color, self, "文字颜色")
        if c.isValid(): self.current_color = c; self.color_btn.setStyleSheet(f"background-color:{c.name()};"); self._schedule_config_save()

    def pick_shadow(self):
        c = QColorDialog.getColor(self.current_shadow_color, self, "阴影颜色")
        if c.isValid():
            self.current_shadow_color = c; self.shadow_btn.setStyleSheet(f"background-color:{c.name()};")
            self._apply_edge_style_live(); self._schedule_config_save()

    def pick_stroke(self):
        c = QColorDialog.getColor(self.current_stroke_color, self, "描边颜色")
        if c.isValid():
            self.current_stroke_color = c; self.stroke_btn.setStyleSheet(f"background-color:{c.name()};")
            self._apply_edge_style_live(); self._schedule_config_save()

    def _refetch_loaded_track_for_mode_switch(self, reason='mode-switch', rollback_trans_only=None, rollback_precise=None):
        """Asynchronously reload the current track after a semantic mode switch."""
        song = str(getattr(self, '_loaded_song', '') or '').strip()
        artist = str(getattr(self, '_loaded_artist', '') or '').strip()
        if not song:
            return False
        source = str(self.source_combo.currentText() or '')
        trans_only = bool(self.trans_check.isChecked())
        self._mode_refetch_generation = int(getattr(self, '_mode_refetch_generation', 0) or 0) + 1
        generation = self._mode_refetch_generation
        self.status.setText(
            f"状态：模式已切换，正在重新获取「{song}」的{'翻译' if trans_only else '原始'}歌词..."
        )

        def worker():
            lyric = None
            duration = 0
            error = ''
            try:
                lyric, duration = LyricSearchEngine.search(song, artist, source, trans_only)
                provider_meta = LyricSearchEngine.last_provider_meta()
                error = LyricSearchEngine.last_error or ''
            except Exception as exc:
                error = f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}'
            try:
                self.mode_lyric_result.emit({
                    'generation': generation, 'reason': reason,
                    'song': song, 'artist': artist, 'source': source,
                    'trans_only': trans_only, 'lyric': lyric,
                    'duration': duration or 0, 'provider_meta': provider_meta if 'provider_meta' in locals() else {}, 'error': error,
                    'rollback_trans_only': rollback_trans_only,
                    'rollback_precise': rollback_precise,
                })
            except Exception:
                pass

        threading.Thread(
            target=worker, name=f'LimbusLyric-ModeRefetch-g{generation}', daemon=True
        ).start()
        return True

    def _rollback_failed_mode_switch(self, result):
        rollback_trans = result.get('rollback_trans_only', None)
        rollback_precise = result.get('rollback_precise', None)
        if rollback_trans is None and rollback_precise is None:
            return
        try:
            if rollback_trans is not None and hasattr(self, 'trans_check'):
                self.trans_check.blockSignals(True)
                self.trans_check.setChecked(bool(rollback_trans))
                self.trans_check.blockSignals(False)
            if rollback_precise is not None and hasattr(self, 'precise_tracking_check'):
                self.precise_tracking_check.blockSignals(True)
                self.precise_tracking_check.setChecked(bool(rollback_precise))
                self.precise_tracking_check.blockSignals(False)
            self._sync_translation_precision_constraint(prefer_translation=bool(rollback_trans))
            if getattr(self, '_is_started', False):
                # The text box still contains the old, valid payload. Relaunch it with the
                # restored switches so renderer state and control state are identical.
                self._launch_current_lyrics(start_delay=0)
            if getattr(self, '_settings_loaded', False):
                self._schedule_config_save()
            write_error_log(
                '模式切换失败已回滚',
                detail=(
                    f"reason={result.get('reason','')} | trans_only={int(bool(rollback_trans))} | "
                    f"precise={int(bool(rollback_precise))}"
                )
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            write_error_log('模式切换回滚失败', exc, detail=f"reason={result.get('reason','')}")

    def _on_mode_lyric_result(self, result):
        generation = int(result.get('generation', -1))
        current = (
            generation == int(getattr(self, '_mode_refetch_generation', 0) or 0) and
            self._same_track(
                str(result.get('song') or ''), str(result.get('artist') or ''),
                str(getattr(self, '_loaded_song', '') or ''), str(getattr(self, '_loaded_artist', '') or '')
            ) and
            str(result.get('source') or '') == str(self.source_combo.currentText() or '') and
            bool(result.get('trans_only')) == bool(self.trans_check.isChecked())
        )
        if not current:
            try:
                write_error_log(
                    '模式切换歌词过期结果丢弃',
                    detail=(
                        f"song={result.get('song','')} | artist={result.get('artist','')} | generation={generation} | "
                        f"current_generation={getattr(self, '_mode_refetch_generation', 0)}"
                    )
                )
            except Exception:
                pass
            return
        lyric = result.get('lyric')
        if not lyric:
            detail = result.get('error') or '未找到歌词'
            self._rollback_failed_mode_switch(result)
            self.status.setText(f"状态：模式切换失败，已恢复切换前状态：{detail}")
            try:
                write_error_log(
                    '模式切换歌词刷新失败',
                    detail=(
                        f"reason={result.get('reason','')} | song={result.get('song','')} | "
                        f"source={result.get('source','')} | trans_only={int(bool(result.get('trans_only')))} | {detail}"
                    )
                )
            except Exception:
                pass
            return

        song = str(result.get('song') or '')
        artist = str(result.get('artist') or '')
        source = str(result.get('source') or '')
        duration = int(result.get('duration') or 0)
        self.text_input.setPlainText(lyric)
        provider_meta = result.get('provider_meta') if isinstance(result.get('provider_meta'), dict) else {}
        ncm_track_id = provider_meta.get('netease_song_id') if source == '网易云' else None
        self.media_sync.bind_track(song, artist, duration, netease_track_id=ncm_track_id)
        self.lyric_window.song_duration = duration
        self._record_loaded_track(song, artist, source)
        if getattr(self, '_is_started', False):
            self._launch_current_lyrics(start_delay=0)
        trans_only = bool(result.get('trans_only'))
        mode_name = '仅翻译行歌词' if trans_only else (
            '精准原始歌词' if self.precise_tracking_check.isChecked() else '原始歌词'
        )
        self.status.setText(f"状态：已切换到{mode_name}并刷新当前歌曲")
        try:
            write_error_log(
                '模式切换歌词已刷新',
                detail=(
                    f"reason={result.get('reason','')} | song={song} | source={source} | "
                    f"trans_only={int(trans_only)} | precise={int(self.precise_tracking_check.isChecked())}"
                )
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _sync_translation_precision_constraint(self, *, prefer_translation=True):
        """Keep the two modes mutually exclusive without disabling either control."""
        if not hasattr(self, 'trans_check') or not hasattr(self, 'precise_tracking_check'):
            return
        trans_only = bool(self.trans_check.isChecked())
        precise = bool(self.precise_tracking_check.isChecked())
        if trans_only and precise:
            if prefer_translation:
                self.precise_tracking_check.blockSignals(True)
                self.precise_tracking_check.setChecked(False)
                self.precise_tracking_check.blockSignals(False)
                precise = False
            else:
                self.trans_check.blockSignals(True)
                self.trans_check.setChecked(False)
                self.trans_check.blockSignals(False)
                trans_only = False
        self.precise_tracking_check.setEnabled(True)
        self.precise_tracking_check.setToolTip('开启精准追踪时会自动关闭“仅获取翻译歌词”。')
        try:
            self.lyric_window.precise_tracking_enabled = bool(precise and not trans_only)
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _on_lyric_source_changed(self, source):
        source = str(source or '')
        if hasattr(self, 'source_support_hint'):
            if source == '酷狗':
                self.source_support_hint.setText('酷狗专项：优先读取可验证的播放器时钟；不可用时回退本地时钟。底部进度条操作可帮助校准；兼容探测只读，不会控制播放。')
                self.source_support_hint.setVisible(True)
            else:
                self.source_support_hint.clear()
                self.source_support_hint.setVisible(False)
        if not hasattr(self, 'trans_check'):
            return
        translation_supported = source in LYRIC_SOURCE_ORDER
        self.trans_check.setEnabled(translation_supported)
        self.trans_check.setToolTip(
            '网易云、QQ音乐、酷狗均支持：先取当前平台翻译，没有时按歌曲身份与版本时长向另外两家借用。开启后自动关闭精准追踪；翻译只保留行/段时间。'
            if translation_supported else '当前歌词源无法参与三平台翻译互补。'
        )
        self._sync_translation_precision_constraint(prefer_translation=True)
        if getattr(self, '_settings_loaded', False): self._schedule_config_save()

    def _on_translation_only_changed(self, state):
        enabled = bool(state == Qt.Checked)
        source = str(self.source_combo.currentText() or '') if hasattr(self, 'source_combo') else ''
        if enabled and source not in LYRIC_SOURCE_ORDER:
            self.trans_check.blockSignals(True); self.trans_check.setChecked(False); self.trans_check.blockSignals(False)
            self.trans_check.setEnabled(False)
            self._sync_translation_precision_constraint(prefer_translation=False)
            return
        was_precise = bool(getattr(self, 'precise_tracking_check', None) and self.precise_tracking_check.isChecked())
        if enabled and was_precise:
            self.precise_tracking_check.blockSignals(True)
            self.precise_tracking_check.setChecked(False)
            self.precise_tracking_check.blockSignals(False)
            try: write_error_log('仅翻译模式自动关闭精准追踪', detail=f'source={source} | precise_tracking=0 | mutual_switch=1')
            except Exception: pass
        self._sync_translation_precision_constraint(prefer_translation=True)
        if getattr(self, '_settings_loaded', False):
            self._schedule_config_save()
            # Translation on/off changes the actual lyric payload, not just presentation.
            # If the provider cannot supply the requested payload, revert the switches so
            # the UI never claims a mode that the currently loaded text cannot satisfy.
            rollback_trans = not enabled
            rollback_precise = bool(was_precise) if enabled else False
            QTimer.singleShot(0, lambda rt=rollback_trans, rp=rollback_precise: self._refetch_loaded_track_for_mode_switch(
                'translation-toggle', rollback_trans_only=rt, rollback_precise=rp
            ))

    def _on_precise_tracking_changed(self, state):
        requested = bool(state == Qt.Checked)
        source = str(self.source_combo.currentText() or '') if hasattr(self, 'source_combo') else ''
        translation_was_enabled = bool(
            requested and hasattr(self, 'trans_check') and self.trans_check.isChecked()
        )
        if translation_was_enabled:
            self.trans_check.blockSignals(True)
            self.trans_check.setChecked(False)
            self.trans_check.blockSignals(False)
            try: write_error_log('精准追踪自动关闭仅翻译模式', detail=f'source={source} | trans_only=0 | mutual_switch=1')
            except Exception: pass
        # If precise is taking over from translation-only, do not let the existing
        # line-level translation render through precise fallback while the correct lyric
        # is still being fetched. _launch_current_lyrics() re-enables it on success.
        enabled = requested and not translation_was_enabled
        if not FLOW_STACK_ENABLED:
            enabled = True
        self.lyric_window.precise_tracking_enabled = enabled
        self.lyric_window._rhythm_event_cache = {}
        if translation_was_enabled and getattr(self, '_settings_loaded', False):
            self._schedule_config_save()
            # The text box still contains line-level translation until it is replaced.
            # Reload the provider lyric before precise tracking renders another frame.
            QTimer.singleShot(0, lambda: self._refetch_loaded_track_for_mode_switch(
                'precise-from-translation', rollback_trans_only=True, rollback_precise=False
            ))
        self.lyric_window._flow_fade_ranges = []
        self.lyric_window._pending_flow_fade_ranges = []
        self.lyric_window._flow_motion_ranges = []
        self.lyric_window._pending_flow_motion_ranges = []
        try:
            if self._is_started and self.lyric_window.lyric_timeline:
                self.lyric_window.check_lyric_time()
        except Exception:
            pass
        if getattr(self, '_settings_loaded', False): self._schedule_config_save()

    def _on_precise_display_mode_changed(self, *_args):
        try:
            mode = str(self.precise_display_combo.currentData() or 'word')
        except Exception:
            mode = 'word'
        if mode not in {'word', 'burst'}:
            mode = 'word'
        self.lyric_window.precise_display_mode = mode
        self.lyric_window._rhythm_event_cache = {}
        self.lyric_window._flow_fade_ranges = []
        self.lyric_window._pending_flow_fade_ranges = []
        self.lyric_window._flow_motion_ranges = []
        self.lyric_window._pending_flow_motion_ranges = []
        try:
            if self._is_started and self.lyric_window.lyric_timeline:
                self.lyric_window.check_lyric_time()
        except Exception:
            pass
        if self._settings_loaded:
            self._schedule_config_save()

    def _on_visible_subtitle_count_changed(self, value):
        value = max(1, min(6, int(value or 1)))
        try:
            self.visible_subtitle_label.setText(str(value))
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.lyric_window.set_max_visible_subtitles(value if FLOW_STACK_ENABLED else 1)

    def _apply_live_sync_offset(self, *_args):
        try:
            player_name = str(self.player_combo.currentText() or '')
            upper_name = player_name.upper()
            if 'QQ' in upper_name:
                self.lyric_window.sync_offset_ms = int(self.qq_sync_offset_spin.value())
            elif '酷狗' in player_name or 'KUGOU' in upper_name or 'KGMUSIC' in upper_name:
                self.lyric_window.sync_offset_ms = int(self.kugou_sync_offset_spin.value())
            else:
                self.lyric_window.sync_offset_ms = int(self.netease_sync_offset_spin.value())
            # “重新校准”目前只有网易云 Bridge 和 QQ 可信时间对实现，酷狗只做显示微调。
            if hasattr(self, 'sync_recalibrate_btn'):
                self.sync_recalibrate_btn.setEnabled(('QQ' in upper_name) or ('网易云' in player_name) or ('NETEASE' in upper_name) or ('CLOUDMUSIC' in upper_name))
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _recalibrate_sync_clock(self):
        try:
            ok, detail = self.media_sync.recalibrate_current_clock()
        except Exception as exc:
            ok, detail = False, f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}'
            write_error_log('手动时钟校准失败', exc)
        try:
            self.status.setText(('状态：' if ok else '状态：校准未执行：') + str(detail or ''))
        except Exception:
            pass
        if ok:
            try:
                self.lyric_window.check_lyric_time()
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _apply_intro_display_mode(self, text):
        mode = str(self.intro_display_combo.currentData() or 'full') if hasattr(self, 'intro_display_combo') else 'full'
        source = str(text or '')
        if mode == 'full' or not source:
            return source
        kept = []
        removed = 0
        first_body_ms = None
        earliest_removed_ms = None
        primary_credits = []
        for raw in source.replace('\r\n', '\n').replace('\r', '\n').split('\n'):
            stripped = raw.strip('\ufeff').strip()
            times, body_raw = _split_lrc_leading_timestamps(stripped)
            body = _sanitize_lrc_body(body_raw) if times else ''
            is_credit = bool(body and (_LRC_CREDIT_BODY_RE.match(body) or _LRC_EXTRA_CREDIT_RE.match(body) or _INTRO_DISPLAY_CREDIT_RE.match(body)))
            if times and is_credit:
                removed += 1
                at = min(int(t) for t in times)
                earliest_removed_ms = at if earliest_removed_ms is None else min(earliest_removed_ms, at)
                if _INTRO_DISPLAY_PRIMARY_CREDIT_RE.match(body):
                    compact = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', str(body or '')).strip()
                    if compact and compact not in primary_credits:
                        primary_credits.append(compact)
                continue
            kept.append(raw)
            if times and body and first_body_ms is None:
                first_body_ms = min(int(t) for t in times)

        card_inserted = 0
        card_at = None
        card_text = ''
        card_modes = {'title', 'title_artist', 'title_credits'}
        if mode in card_modes and first_body_ms is not None and first_body_ms >= 900:
            song = str(getattr(self, '_loaded_song', '') or '').strip()
            artist = str(getattr(self, '_loaded_artist', '') or '').strip()
            if song:
                card_text = f'♫ {song}'
                if mode == 'title_artist' and artist:
                    card_text += f' — {artist}'
                elif mode == 'title_credits' and primary_credits:
                    summary = ' · '.join(primary_credits[:2])
                    if summary:
                        card_text += f'　·　{summary}'
                # Keep the synthetic card deliberately compact. A provider credit line can
                # contain studios, URLs, or many collaborators; those belong in full mode.
                if len(card_text) > 180:
                    card_text = card_text[:177].rstrip() + '…'
                candidate = max(0, int(first_body_ms) - 1800)
                if earliest_removed_ms is not None:
                    candidate = max(0, min(candidate, int(earliest_removed_ms)))
                if int(first_body_ms) - candidate >= 420:
                    kept.append(f'[{_format_lrc_ms(candidate)}]{card_text}')
                    card_inserted = 1
                    card_at = candidate
        out = '\n'.join(kept).strip()
        try:
            write_error_log(
                '片头显示策略',
                detail=(f'mode={mode} | credits_removed={removed} | primary_credits={len(primary_credits)} | '
                        f'card_inserted={card_inserted} | card_at={card_at} | first_body={first_body_ms}')
            )
        except Exception:
            pass
        return out

    def _on_intro_display_mode_changed(self, *_args):
        self._schedule_config_save()
        if self._settings_loaded and self._is_started and self.text_input.toPlainText().strip():
            try:
                self._launch_current_lyrics(start_delay=0)
            except Exception as exc:
                write_error_log('切换片头显示策略失败', exc)

    def _launch_current_lyrics(self, start_delay=0):
        # Final safety barrier: no code path may display an overlay in an unarmed session.
        if not self._is_started:
            try:
                write_error_log(
                    '阻止未启动字幕显示',
                    detail=f'pid={os.getpid()} | auto_armed={int(self._auto_armed)}'
                )
            except Exception:
                pass
            self.lyric_window.hide()
            return False
        text = self.text_input.toPlainText().strip()
        if not text:
            return False
        text = self._apply_intro_display_mode(text)
        if not text:
            return False
        song_style = dict(getattr(self, '_active_song_style', {}) or {})
        # Random/manual/DIY all resolve to the same three visual values before entering
        # the renderer. No lifecycle or timing branch is selected by style mode.
        font, styled_color, styled_glow_color = self._resolved_active_visual_style()
        try:
            sample = self._safe_font_sample(text)
            coverage_ok = int(bool(self._font_supports_sample(font.family(), sample)))
            write_error_log('桌面渲染样式解析', detail=(
                f'font={font.family()} | size={font.pointSize()} | coverage={coverage_ok} | '
                f'text={styled_color.name()} | glow={styled_glow_color.name()} | '
                f'random_font={int(bool(hasattr(self, "random_font_check") and self.random_font_check.isChecked()))} | '
                f'random_color={int(bool(hasattr(self, "random_color_check") and self.random_color_check.isChecked()))}'
            ))
        except Exception:
            pass
        global_effect = str(self.entrance_effect_combo.currentData() or 'smart') if hasattr(self, 'entrance_effect_combo') else 'smart'
        style_effect = str(song_style.get('entrance_effect') or 'inherit')
        self.lyric_window.entrance_effect = global_effect if style_effect == 'inherit' else style_effect
        global_western_effect = str(self.western_entrance_effect_combo.currentData() or 'inherit') if hasattr(self, 'western_entrance_effect_combo') else 'inherit'
        style_western_effect = str(song_style.get('western_entrance_effect') or 'inherit')
        self.lyric_window.western_entrance_effect = global_western_effect if style_western_effect == 'inherit' else style_western_effect
        mode = self.mode_combo.currentData()
        self.lyric_window.loop = self.loop_check.isChecked()
        self.lyric_window.shadow_enabled = self.shadow_check.isChecked()
        self.lyric_window.shadow_color = QColor(self.current_shadow_color)
        self.lyric_window.outline_enabled = self.outline_check.isChecked()
        self.lyric_window.stroke_color = QColor(self.current_stroke_color)
        self.lyric_window.stroke_width = float(self.stroke_spin.value())
        self.lyric_window.horizontal_wrap = self.wrap_check.isChecked()
        self.lyric_window.seek_trail_enabled = self.seek_trail_check.isChecked()
        self.lyric_window.seek_entry_fade_enabled = self.seek_entry_fade_check.isChecked()
        self.lyric_window.precise_tracking_enabled = (self.precise_tracking_check.isChecked() if FLOW_STACK_ENABLED else True) and not self.trans_check.isChecked()
        self.lyric_window.precise_display_mode = str(self.precise_display_combo.currentData() or 'word') if FLOW_STACK_ENABLED else 'word'
        self.lyric_window.set_max_visible_subtitles(self.visible_subtitle_slider.value() if FLOW_STACK_ENABLED else 1)
        player_name = self.player_combo.currentText()
        process_name = self.players.get(player_name, {}).get('process', '')
        self.lyric_window.set_audio_emphasis(
            bool(self.audio_emphasis_check.isChecked()) if hasattr(self, 'audio_emphasis_check') else False,
            int(self.audio_emphasis_strength_slider.value()) if hasattr(self, 'audio_emphasis_strength_slider') else int(AUDIO_EMPHASIS_DEFAULT_MAX_SCALE_PCT),
            process_name,
            int(self.audio_emphasis_trigger_slider.value()) if hasattr(self, 'audio_emphasis_trigger_slider') else int(AUDIO_EMPHASIS_TRIGGER_DEFAULT_PCT),
            int(self.audio_emphasis_full_slider.value()) if hasattr(self, 'audio_emphasis_full_slider') else int(AUDIO_EMPHASIS_FULL_DEFAULT_PCT),
            int(self.audio_emphasis_min_delta_spin.value()) if hasattr(self, 'audio_emphasis_min_delta_spin') else int(round(AUDIO_EMPHASIS_MIN_MEANINGFUL_SCALE_DELTA * 100.0))
        )
        self._apply_live_sync_offset()
        if PHASE_SEEK_FIX_ENABLED:
            try:
                write_error_log(
                    '歌词同步相位设置',
                    detail=(
                        f'player={player_name} | user_offset={int(self.lyric_window.sync_offset_ms)}ms | '
                        f'netease_bridge_lead={NETEASE_INTERNAL_BRIDGE_VISUAL_LEAD_MS}ms uniform_precise=1 seek_phase=direct | netease_uia_fallback_phase=360ms(resume-ramp) | precise_visual_lead={PRECISE_VISUAL_LEAD_MS}ms | qq_visual_extra={QQ_PRECISE_VISUAL_EXTRA_MS}ms | tracking={int(bool(getattr(self.lyric_window, "precise_tracking_enabled", True)))} | precise_display={getattr(self.lyric_window, "precise_display_mode", "word")} | entrance={getattr(self.lyric_window, "entrance_effect", "smart")} | western_entrance={getattr(self.lyric_window, "western_entrance_effect", "inherit")} | random_font={int(bool(hasattr(self, "random_font_check") and self.random_font_check.isChecked()))} | random_color={int(bool(hasattr(self, "random_color_check") and self.random_color_check.isChecked()))}'
                    )
                )
            except Exception:
                pass
        try:
            self.media_sync.set_lyric_click_timeline(text)
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.media_sync.start(process_name)
        self.lyric_window.show(); self.lyric_window.raise_()

        # Lyric-source timing profile only; renderer itself has no QQ branch.
        timing_tail_override_ms = None
        timing_active_cap_ms = None
        if self.source_combo.currentText() == "QQ音乐":
            # QQ ordinary LRC has no per-character clock. The old fixed 900ms tail made
            # short lines systematically finish too early; retain a smaller breathing tail.
            timing_tail_override_ms = 320 if STABILITY_FIXES_ENABLED else 900
            timing_active_cap_ms = 5200

        self.lyric_window.start_lyric(
            text, font, styled_color, self.current_stroke_color,
            self.stroke_spin.value(), self.angle_min.value(), self.angle_max.value(),
            self.margin_spin.value(), self.max_interval_spin.value(), self.max_duration_spin.value(),
            mode, self.spacing_spin.value(), self.shake_intensity_slider.value(),
            self.shake_speed_slider.value(), self.fade_speed_slider.value(),
            self.rise_speed_slider.value(), self.glow_check.isChecked(),
            styled_glow_color, self.glow_size_slider.value(),
            self.glow_alpha_slider.value(), start_delay=int(start_delay),
            timing_tail_override_ms=timing_tail_override_ms,
            timing_active_cap_ms=timing_active_cap_ms
        )
        return True

    def start(self):
        text = self.text_input.toPlainText().strip()
        if not text:
            self.status.setText("状态：请先输入歌词！")
            return

        if not self._loaded_track_key:
            # 用户可能手工粘贴了歌词；第一次开始时把当前媒体当作基线，
            # 不要把当前歌误判成“刚切的新歌”。
            song, artist = self._detected_player_track()
            if song:
                self._record_loaded_track(song, artist, self.source_combo.currentText())

        # 本次进程只有这里能从“未武装”进入“已武装”。
        self._is_started = True
        self._auto_armed = self.auto_track_check.isChecked()
        self._zero_touch_armed = False
        try:
            write_error_log(
                '用户点击开始',
                detail=(
                    f'pid={os.getpid()} | auto_armed={int(self._auto_armed)} | '
                    f'loaded={self._loaded_track_key or "<manual>"}'
                )
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

        delay = int(self.delay_combo.currentText().replace('s', ''))
        if not self._launch_current_lyrics(start_delay=delay):
            self._is_started = False
            self._auto_armed = False
            self.lyric_window.hide()
            return
        if self.media_sync.available:
            sync_text = "混合同步已启用（UIA进度 + Windows播放状态）"
        elif os.environ.get("LIMBUS_DISABLE_GSMTC", "").strip() == "1":
            sync_text = "安全模式：GSMTC已禁用，仍尝试UIA读取播放器进度"
        else:
            detail = GSMTC_BACKEND_ERROR or "WinRT 媒体依赖不可用"
            sync_text = f"媒体同步不可用，暂用本地计时（{detail}）"
        auto_text = "；自动读词已开启" if self._auto_armed else ""
        self.status.setText(f"状态：正在播放... {sync_text}{auto_text}")

    def stop(self):
        self.lyric_window.stop_lyric()
        self.lyric_window.hide()
        self._cancel_auto_jobs(keep_armed=False)
        self._is_started = False
        self._zero_touch_armed = False
        try:
            write_error_log('用户点击停止', detail=f'pid={os.getpid()}')
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.status.setText("状态：已停止；自动读词已暂停，点击开始重新启用")
    def changeEvent(self, event):
        super().changeEvent(event)
        if event.type() == QEvent.WindowStateChange and hasattr(self, 'window_title_bar'):
            self.window_title_bar.sync_window_state()

    def nativeEvent(self, eventType, message):
        """Restore native four-edge/corner resize hit zones for the frameless panel on Windows."""
        if os.name == 'nt' and not self.isMaximized():
            try:
                class _MSG(ctypes.Structure):
                    _fields_ = [
                        ('hwnd', ctypes.c_void_p),
                        ('message', ctypes.c_uint),
                        ('wParam', ctypes.c_size_t),
                        ('lParam', ctypes.c_ssize_t),
                        ('time', ctypes.c_uint),
                        ('pt_x', ctypes.c_long),
                        ('pt_y', ctypes.c_long),
                    ]
                class _POINT(ctypes.Structure):
                    _fields_ = [('x', ctypes.c_long), ('y', ctypes.c_long)]
                class _RECT(ctypes.Structure):
                    _fields_ = [('left', ctypes.c_long), ('top', ctypes.c_long),
                                ('right', ctypes.c_long), ('bottom', ctypes.c_long)]

                ptr = int(message)
                msg = _MSG.from_address(ptr)
                WM_NCHITTEST = 0x0084
                if msg.message == WM_NCHITTEST:
                    user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
                    pt = _POINT()
                    rect = _RECT()
                    if user32.GetCursorPos(ctypes.byref(pt)) and user32.GetWindowRect(msg.hwnd, ctypes.byref(rect)):
                        try:
                            dpr = max(1.0, float(self.devicePixelRatioF()))
                        except Exception:
                            dpr = 1.0
                        border = max(5, int(round(float(getattr(self, '_frame_resize_border_px', 8)) * dpr)))
                        on_left = rect.left <= pt.x < rect.left + border
                        on_right = rect.right - border <= pt.x < rect.right
                        on_top = rect.top <= pt.y < rect.top + border
                        on_bottom = rect.bottom - border <= pt.y < rect.bottom

                        if on_top and on_left:
                            return True, 13   # HTTOPLEFT
                        if on_top and on_right:
                            return True, 14   # HTTOPRIGHT
                        if on_bottom and on_left:
                            return True, 16   # HTBOTTOMLEFT
                        if on_bottom and on_right:
                            return True, 17   # HTBOTTOMRIGHT
                        if on_left:
                            return True, 10   # HTLEFT
                        if on_right:
                            return True, 11   # HTRIGHT
                        if on_top:
                            return True, 12   # HTTOP
                        if on_bottom:
                            return True, 15   # HTBOTTOM
            except Exception:
                # Keep Qt's normal dispatch as a safe fallback on unusual Windows/PyQt builds.
                pass
        return super().nativeEvent(eventType, message)

    def resizeEvent(self, event):
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        self._schedule_config_save()

    def moveEvent(self, event):
        super().moveEvent(event)
        self._schedule_config_save()

    def closeEvent(self, event):
        if not self._quitting and getattr(self, 'tray_icon', None) is not None and self.close_to_tray_check.isChecked():
            self._save_config_now()
            self.hide()
            event.ignore()
            return
        self._save_config_now()
        try: self.media_sync.stop()
        except Exception: pass
        try: self.lyric_window.close()
        except Exception: pass
        try: self.tray_icon.hide()
        except Exception: pass
        event.accept()
        QTimer.singleShot(0, QApplication.quit)

def _global_exception_hook(exc_type, exc_value, exc_tb):
    try:
        text = "".join(traceback.format_exception(exc_type, exc_value, exc_tb))
        write_error_log("未捕获异常", detail=text)
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        sys.__excepthook__(exc_type, exc_value, exc_tb)
    except Exception:
        pass


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.excepthook = _global_exception_hook
    try:
        if not _acquire_single_instance():
            try:
                ctypes.windll.user32.MessageBoxW(
                    None,
                    f"LimbusLyric 已经在运行。\n\n你正在启动：{LIMBUSLYRIC_BUILD_TAG}\n\n请先在系统托盘把旧实例完全退出，再启动当前测试版。",
                    f"LimbusLyric · {LIMBUSLYRIC_BUILD_TAG}",
                    0x40
                )
            except Exception:
                pass
            sys.exit(0)
        app = QApplication(sys.argv)
        app_icon = _application_icon()
        if not app_icon.isNull():
            app.setWindowIcon(app_icon)
        panel = ControlPanel()
        if not app_icon.isNull():
            panel.setWindowIcon(app_icon)
        screen = app.primaryScreen().availableGeometry()
        if not getattr(panel, '_geometry_restored', False):
            x = screen.left() + max(0, (screen.width() - panel.width()) // 2)
            y = screen.top() + max(0, (screen.height() - panel.height()) // 2)
            panel.move(x, y)
        autostart_hidden = ('--autostart' in sys.argv and panel.startup_minimized_check.isChecked())
        if not autostart_hidden:
            panel.show()
            if getattr(panel, '_restore_maximized', False):
                panel.showMaximized()
            panel.raise_(); panel.activateWindow()
        app.setQuitOnLastWindowClosed(False)
        sys.exit(app.exec_())
    except Exception as exc:
        write_error_log("程序启动失败", exc)
        print("FATAL STARTUP ERROR:", file=sys.stderr)
        traceback.print_exc()
        sys.exit(1)
